knowledge.text: 只把測試案例數 cases 從 120 改成 121 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 19 變為 19.1333 h。先說明「跨層動線驗證安排」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only test cases cases from 120 to 121 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 19 to 19.1333 h. Explain the causal direction for planning multilevel route verification, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「跨層動線驗證安排」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Planning multilevel route verification"?
options: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
電梯每小時往返次數可以直接當作每小時服務人數
optionsEn: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Elevator round trips per hour can directly be treated as passengers served per hour.
quiz.explanation: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 跨層動線驗證安排：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Planning multilevel route verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「跨層動線驗證安排」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Planning multilevel route verification” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「跨層動線驗證安排」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for planning multilevel route verification. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「跨層動線驗證安排」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for planning multilevel route verification. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「跨層動線驗證安排」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Planning multilevel route verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。
兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort.
Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
quiz.explanation: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 軌道運輸無障礙月台
summary: 本課聚焦月台車輛幾何介面與連續無障礙路徑。從月台與車體界限建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把無障礙完整旅程與協助登乘時間連成可驗證的介面，最後以使用性測試推論整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies platform–vehicle geometry and continuous accessible journeys. Start with platform and vehicle bounds to define physical or information boundaries, connect complete accessible journey time with assisted boarding time as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through inference from usability trials. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究月台與車體界限。原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。公式 y=track+body+survey，代入得 y=21 mm。邊界：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。敏感度只改 body=10 至 11 mm，輸出變為 22 mm；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究重複量測與共同偏差：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate platform and vehicle bounds. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm. Formula y=track+body+survey gives y=21 mm. Boundary: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. For sensitivity, change only body=10 to 11 mm; the output becomes 22 mm. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate repeated observations and shared bias: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 月台與車體界限與重複量測與共同偏差
stages.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds & Repeated observations and shared bias
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「月台與車體界限」與「重複量測與共同偏差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Platform and vehicle bounds" and "Repeated observations and shared bias": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 月台與車體界限：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「月台與車體界限」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Platform and vehicle bounds” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。月台與車體介面的間隙預算需分開列入軌道幾何、懸吊移動與測量誤差。保守界限可直接相加，而隨機誤差合成必須有分布與相關性證據；只在空車靜止狀態量一個間隙，無法代表載重與動態情境。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「月台與車體界限」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load. A platform-vehicle gap budget separates track geometry, suspension movement and survey error. Conservative bounds can be summed, while stochastic combination requires evidence for distributions and correlation. One stationary empty-vehicle measurement cannot represent loaded and dynamic conditions. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Platform and vehicle bounds” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「月台與車體界限」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Platform and vehicle bounds”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 月台與車體界限
knowledge.text: 本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。月台與車體介面的間隙預算需分開列入軌道幾何、懸吊移動與測量誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load. A platform-vehicle gap budget separates track geometry, suspension movement and survey error.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「月台與車體界限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Platform and vehicle bounds" is correct?
options: 三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限
本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
optionsEn: Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination.
Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 月台與車體界限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「月台與車體界限」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Platform and vehicle bounds” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。公式 y=track+body+survey，代入得 y=21 mm。邊界：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm. Formula y=track+body+survey gives y=21 mm. Boundary: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立共同座標，對空載、載重及不同車型分別量測，並保留各誤差來源的符號。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish one coordinate system, measure empty and loaded vehicles of each type, and retain signs of individual error sources.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。公式 y=track+body+survey，代入得 y=21 mm。邊界：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm. Formula y=track+body+survey gives y=21 mm. Boundary: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「月台與車體界限」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Platform and vehicle bounds", which statement holds?
options: 平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑
照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口
原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。
optionsEn: The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 月台與車體界限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「月台與車體界限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Platform and vehicle bounds” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立共同座標，對空載、載重及不同車型分別量測，並保留各誤差來源的符號。以「月台與車體界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish one coordinate system, measure empty and loaded vehicles of each type, and retain signs of individual error sources. For platform and vehicle bounds, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. steps.instruction: 把最大值當成標準差再作均方根合成會失去保守性，基準點沉陷也會造成整排讀值偏移。回到「月台與車體界限」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 重複量測與共同偏差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Repeated observations and shared bias: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重複量測與共同偏差」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Repeated observations and shared bias” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元用重複讀值估算分散，再用獨立基準辨認共同偏差，避免重複次數增加帶來虛假的信心。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。這個做法不適合直接合併最大容差或共同偏差；一旦共享基準造成相關性，協方差項就必須回到計算中，不能繼續假裝量測彼此獨立。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重複量測與共同偏差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate spread from repeated readings and use an independent reference to identify shared bias, avoiding false confidence from repetition alone. Variances of independent zero-mean errors add, giving a root-sum-square standard deviation. This is not a way to combine maximum tolerances or common bias. When a shared datum creates correlation, covariance terms belong in the calculation rather than assuming continued independence. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Repeated observations and shared bias” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm.

steps.instruction: 本單元同時保留長向高差與橫向排水需求，將整段平均坡度與輪椅實際輪跡局部坡度比較。坡度以高差除以水平長度定義，不能把斜面長度直接當分母。平均坡度之外還要檢查平台、橫坡與轉折，因為輪椅使用者在坡道終端需要轉向與停止的空間；符合一個幾何比值並不代表整條無障礙路徑連續可用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：幾何教學值，不宣告符合任何司法區的坡道上限。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡道縱橫坡分離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：高差 rise=0.45 m；水平長度 run=7.5 m。公式 y=rise/run*100，代入得 y=6 percent。邊界：幾何教學值，不宣告符合任何司法區的坡道上限。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.instruction: 兩端平均坡度合格仍可能隱藏短距離陡坡，排水沉陷又可能造成輪椅偏向。回到「坡道縱橫坡分離」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An acceptable endpoint average can hide a short steep segment, while drainage settlement can introduce a destabilizing cross-slope. Trace the input chain for separating ramp slope and cross-slope. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 無障礙完整旅程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Complete accessible journey time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「無障礙完整旅程」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Complete accessible journey time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元從站外入口追蹤至車廂的連續路徑，將電梯等待、開門與協助時間納入相同系統邊界。總旅行時間應同時計入移動與等待，不能只比較平面上的最短距離。坡道、門扇與轉乘決策都可能造成停頓；對行動受限旅客而言，較遠但連續可達的路徑往往比短而不連續的路徑更可用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「無障礙完整旅程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Trace a continuous journey from the external entrance to the carriage, including lift waits, doors and assistance within one system boundary. Travel time includes movement and waiting rather than plan distance alone. Ramps, doors and transfer decisions can introduce pauses. For a mobility-limited traveller, a longer continuously accessible route can be more usable than a shorter route containing an inaccessible interruption. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Complete accessible journey time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「無障礙完整旅程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Complete accessible journey time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Trace a continuous journey from the external entrance to the carriage, including lift waits, doors and assistance within one system boundary. Travel time includes movement and waiting rather than plan distance alone.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「無障礙完整旅程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

本單元從站外入口追蹤至車廂的連續路徑，將電梯等待、開門與協助時間納入相同系統邊界。

optionsEn: The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
Trace a continuous journey from the external entrance to the carriage, including lift waits, doors and assistance within one system boundary.
Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.

steps.title: 無障礙完整旅程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Complete accessible journey time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「無障礙完整旅程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Complete accessible journey time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=185 s。邊界：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=185 s. Boundary: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「無障礙完整旅程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 無障礙完整旅程：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「無障礙完整旅程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Complete accessible journey time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。以「無障礙完整旅程」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities. For complete accessible journey time, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把假想步速 speed 從 0.8 改成 0.88 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 185 變為 171.364 s。先說明「無障礙完整旅程」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for complete accessible journey time, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. Trace the input chain for complete accessible journey time. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「無障礙完整旅程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Complete accessible journey time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。
兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time.
Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
quiz.explanation: 只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 輔具通行有效空間與視覺辨識與暗點
stages.titleEn: Clear space for mobility aids & Visual recognition and dark areas
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「輔具通行有效空間」與「視覺辨識與暗點」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Clear space for mobility aids" and "Visual recognition and dark areas": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輔具通行有效空間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Clear space for mobility aids: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「輔具通行有效空間」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Clear space for mobility aids” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把門扇、立柱與轉彎路徑視為幾何限制，明確區分通道流率算例與個人可通行性。通道容量與有效淨寬有關，但扶手、門扇、行李及靠邊避讓會減少可用寬度。單位寬流率是情境參數，受方向、坡度與群體能力影響；多條通道的容量只有在下游沒有共同瓶頸時才能直接相加。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輔具通行有效空間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Treat door leaves, columns and turning paths as geometric constraints, distinguishing a passage-flow calculation from individual passability. Passage capacity depends on effective clear width, reduced by rails, door leaves, luggage and edge avoidance. Specific flow is scenario dependent and varies with direction, slope and user capability. Parallel passage capacities may be added only when they do not share a downstream bottleneck. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Clear space for mobility aids” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「輔具通行有效空間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Clear space for mobility aids”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輔具通行有效空間
knowledge.text: 本單元把門扇、立柱與轉彎路徑視為幾何限制，明確區分通道流率算例與個人可通行性。通道容量與有效淨寬有關，但扶手、門扇、行李及靠邊避讓會減少可用寬度。
knowledge.textEn: Treat door leaves, columns and turning paths as geometric constraints, distinguishing a passage-flow calculation from individual passability. Passage capacity depends on effective clear width, reduced by rails, door leaves, luggage and edge avoidance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輔具通行有效空間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Clear space for mobility aids" is correct?
options: 兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口
本單元把門扇、立柱與轉彎路徑視為幾何限制，明確區分通道流率算例與個人可通行性。
optionsEn: Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
Treat door leaves, columns and turning paths as geometric constraints, distinguishing a passage-flow calculation from individual passability.
quiz.explanation: 本單元把門扇、立柱與轉彎路徑視為幾何限制，明確區分通道流率算例與個人可通行性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Treat door leaves, columns and turning paths as geometric constraints, distinguishing a passage-flow calculation from individual passability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輔具通行有效空間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Clear space for mobility aids: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輔具通行有效空間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Clear space for mobility aids” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。公式 y=width*specific，代入得 y=2.64 persons/s。邊界：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Formula y=width*specific gives y=2.64 persons/s. Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。公式 y=width*specific，代入得 y=2.64 persons/s。邊界：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Formula y=width*specific gives y=2.64 persons/s. Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「輔具通行有效空間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Clear space for mobility aids", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。
出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s).
Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輔具通行有效空間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Clear space for mobility aids: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「輔具通行有效空間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Clear space for mobility aids” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。以「輔具通行有效空間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues. For clear space for mobility aids, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把有效淨寬 width 從 2.4 改成 2.64 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.64 變為 2.904 persons/s。先說明「輔具通行有效空間」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only effective clear width width from 2.4 to 2.64 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2.64 to 2.904 persons/s. Explain the causal direction for clear space for mobility aids, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以建築軸線寬度代替淨寬會高估容量，出口匯流也可能讓上游兩條通道互相阻塞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using structural width instead of clear width overstates capacity; merging exits can make two upstream passages obstruct each other. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。以「輔具通行有效空間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues. For clear space for mobility aids, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.text: 只把有效淨寬 width 從 2.4 改成 2.64 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.64 變為 2.904 persons/s。先說明「輔具通行有效空間」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for clear space for mobility aids, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輔具通行有效空間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Clear space for mobility aids"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
quiz.explanation: 量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 輔具通行有效空間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Clear space for mobility aids: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輔具通行有效空間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Clear space for mobility aids” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以建築軸線寬度代替淨寬會高估容量，出口匯流也可能讓上游兩條通道互相阻塞。回到「輔具通行有效空間」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using structural width instead of clear width overstates capacity; merging exits can make two upstream passages obstruct each other. Trace the input chain for clear space for mobility aids. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Trace the input chain for clear space for mobility aids. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

quiz.question: 在「輔具通行有效空間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Clear space for mobility aids" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口
以建築軸線寬度代替淨寬會高估容量，出口匯流也可能讓上游兩條通道互相阻塞。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
Using structural width instead of clear width overstates capacity; merging exits can make two upstream passages obstruct each other.
quiz.explanation: 以建築軸線寬度代替淨寬會高估容量，出口匯流也可能讓上游兩條通道互相阻塞。 需以量測區分可能原因。

steps.title: 視覺辨識與暗點：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Visual recognition and dark areas: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「視覺辨識與暗點」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Visual recognition and dark areas” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較月台邊緣、指標與車門前的照度分布，檢查平均值是否掩蓋弱視旅客需要辨認的暗點。平均照度由到達工作面的光通量除以面積估算，但光學分布決定暗點是否存在。煙氣、污損與電池老化可能同時降低可見性；指示方向、對比與旅客視力也會影響辨識，不能只用燈具是否亮著作為完成檢核。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻平均照度估算，未模擬煙氣散射或法定最低照度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「視覺辨識與暗點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare lighting at platform edges, signs and doors, checking whether an average hides dark areas important to passengers with low vision. Mean illuminance divides useful luminous flux by area, but optical distribution determines dark spots. Smoke, dirt and battery ageing can reduce visibility together. Directional cues, contrast and eyesight affect recognition, so a lamp being on is not a complete verification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Visual recognition and dark areas” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：光通量 flux=2400 lm；利用係數 util=0.45 1；受照面積 area=24 m2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: luminous flux flux=2400 lm; utilization factor util=0.45 1; illuminated area area=24 m2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「視覺辨識與暗點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Visual recognition and dark areas”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 視覺辨識與暗點
knowledge.text: 本單元比較月台邊緣、指標與車門前的照度分布，檢查平均值是否掩蓋弱視旅客需要辨認的暗點。平均照度由到達工作面的光通量除以面積估算，但光學分布決定暗點是否存在。
knowledge.textEn: Compare lighting at platform edges, signs and doors, checking whether an average hides dark areas important to passengers with low vision. Mean illuminance divides useful luminous flux by area, but optical distribution determines dark spots.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「視覺辨識與暗點」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Visual recognition and dark areas" is correct?
options: 本單元比較月台邊緣、指標與車門前的照度分布，檢查平均值是否掩蓋弱視旅客需要辨認的暗點。
照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口
總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
optionsEn: Compare lighting at platform edges, signs and doors, checking whether an average hides dark areas important to passengers with low vision.
Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
quiz.explanation: 本單元比較月台邊緣、指標與車門前的照度分布，檢查平均值是否掩蓋弱視旅客需要辨認的暗點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare lighting at platform edges, signs and doors, checking whether an average hides dark areas important to passengers with low vision. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 視覺辨識與暗點：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Visual recognition and dark areas: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「視覺辨識與暗點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Visual recognition and dark areas” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：光通量 flux=2400 lm；利用係數 util=0.45 1；受照面積 area=24 m2。公式 y=flux*util/area，代入得 y=45 lx。邊界：均勻平均照度估算，未模擬煙氣散射或法定最低照度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: luminous flux flux=2400 lm; utilization factor util=0.45 1; illuminated area area=24 m2. Formula y=flux*util/area gives y=45 lx. Boundary: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以網格量測平面照度並尋找最低點，對照電池放電前後與不同觀看方向。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure illuminance on a grid, identify minima, and compare before/after battery discharge and different viewing directions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：光通量 flux=2400 lm；利用係數 util=0.45 1；受照面積 area=24 m2。公式 y=flux*util/area，代入得 y=45 lx。邊界：均勻平均照度估算，未模擬煙氣散射或法定最低照度。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: luminous flux flux=2400 lm; utilization factor util=0.45 1; illuminated area area=24 m2. Formula y=flux*util/area gives y=45 lx. Boundary: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「視覺辨識與暗點」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Visual recognition and dark areas", which statement holds?
options: 測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
原創假想教學輸入：光通量 flux=2400 lm；利用係數 util=0.45 1；受照面積 area=24 m2。
三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限
optionsEn: One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: luminous flux flux=2400 lm; utilization factor util=0.45 1; illuminated area area=24 m2.
Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：光通量 flux=2400 lm；利用係數 util=0.45 1；受照面積 area=24 m2。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: luminous flux flux=2400 lm; utilization factor util=0.45 1; illuminated area area=24 m2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 視覺辨識與暗點：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Visual recognition and dark areas: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「視覺辨識與暗點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Visual recognition and dark areas” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以網格量測平面照度並尋找最低點，對照電池放電前後與不同觀看方向。以「視覺辨識與暗點」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure illuminance on a grid, identify minima, and compare before/after battery discharge and different viewing directions. For visual recognition and dark areas, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把光通量 flux 從 2400 改成 2640 lm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 45 變為 49.5 lx。先說明「視覺辨識與暗點」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only luminous flux flux from 2400 to 2640 lm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 45 to 49.5 lx. Explain the causal direction for visual recognition and dark areas, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：亮度集中在燈具下方可能留下暗區，指示牌反光也可降低遠距離的有效對比。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Light concentrated beneath fixtures leaves dark regions; sign glare can also reduce effective contrast at a distance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

quiz.question: 要驗證「視覺辨識與暗點」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Visual recognition and dark areas"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只要坡道平均坡度適當就不用檢查平台與橫坡

An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope.
Measure illuminance on a grid, identify minima, and compare before/after battery discharge and different viewing directions.
quiz.explanation: 以網格量測平面照度並尋找最低點，對照電池放電前後與不同觀看方向。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

steps.title: 視覺辨識與暗點：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Visual recognition and dark areas: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「視覺辨識與暗點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Visual recognition and dark areas” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 亮度集中在燈具下方可能留下暗區，指示牌反光也可降低遠距離的有效對比。回到「視覺辨識與暗點」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Light concentrated beneath fixtures leaves dark regions; sign glare can also reduce effective contrast at a distance. Trace the input chain for visual recognition and dark areas. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻平均照度估算，未模擬煙氣散射或法定最低照度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 亮度集中在燈具下方可能留下暗區，指示牌反光也可降低遠距離的有效對比。回到「視覺辨識與暗點」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Light concentrated beneath fixtures leaves dark regions; sign glare can also reduce effective contrast at a distance. Trace the input chain for visual recognition and dark areas. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 協助登乘時間與電梯服務需求累積
stages.titleEn: Assisted boarding time & Accumulating demand for elevators
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「協助登乘時間」與「電梯服務需求累積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Assisted boarding time" and "Accumulating demand for elevators": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 協助登乘時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Assisted boarding time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「協助登乘時間」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Assisted boarding time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把一般旅客交換與協助登乘分成可重疊或不可重疊工作，避免用平均停站時間壓縮必要協助。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。各門均分旅客時可用總服務率估算，但熱門樓梯旁的門通常更壅塞；瓶頸門完成時間控制發車，平均流率因此不能保證最忙車門也能按時結束。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「協助登乘時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate ordinary exchange and assisted boarding into overlapping and non-overlapping tasks, avoiding pressure to compress assistance into an average dwell. Dwell includes passenger service and fixed door sequences. Dividing by total service rate assumes an even passenger distribution, yet doors near popular stairs are often more crowded. The busiest door governs completion, so average flow cannot guarantee timely clearance at that door. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Assisted boarding time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「協助登乘時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Assisted boarding time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 協助登乘時間
knowledge.text: 本單元把一般旅客交換與協助登乘分成可重疊或不可重疊工作，避免用平均停站時間壓縮必要協助。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。
knowledge.textEn: Separate ordinary exchange and assisted boarding into overlapping and non-overlapping tasks, avoiding pressure to compress assistance into an average dwell. Dwell includes passenger service and fixed door sequences.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「協助登乘時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Assisted boarding time" is correct?
options: 總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
本單元把一般旅客交換與協助登乘分成可重疊或不可重疊工作，避免用平均停站時間壓縮必要協助。
出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
optionsEn: Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
Separate ordinary exchange and assisted boarding into overlapping and non-overlapping tasks, avoiding pressure to compress assistance into an average dwell.
Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
quiz.explanation: 本單元把一般旅客交換與協助登乘分成可重疊或不可重疊工作，避免用平均停站時間壓縮必要協助。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate ordinary exchange and assisted boarding into overlapping and non-overlapping tasks, avoiding pressure to compress assistance into an average dwell. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 協助登乘時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Assisted boarding time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「協助登乘時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Assisted boarding time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。公式 y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed，代入得 y=30.75 s。邊界：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s. Formula y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed gives y=30.75 s. Boundary: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「協助登乘時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 協助登乘時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Assisted boarding time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「協助登乘時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Assisted boarding time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。以「協助登乘時間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean. For assisted boarding time, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把登車人數 N 從 180 改成 181 persons（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30.75 變為 30.8542 s。先說明「協助登乘時間」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only boarding passengers N from 180 to 181 persons (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 30.75 to 30.8542 s. Explain the causal direction for assisted boarding time, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「協助登乘時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Assisted boarding time"?
options: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。

Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.

steps.title: 協助登乘時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Assisted boarding time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「協助登乘時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Assisted boarding time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。回到「協助登乘時間」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Trace the input chain for assisted boarding time. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

quiz.question: 在「協助登乘時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 電梯服務需求累積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Accumulating demand for elevators: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「電梯服務需求累積」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Accumulating demand for elevators” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元追蹤行動受限者及攜行李旅客的共同需求，保留無法立即進入下一班電梯的人數。排隊人數依流入減流出的守恆關係累積。平均服務能力若只略高於平均需求，瞬間車潮仍會形成等待；人群不能被無限壓縮，所以排隊長度會回堵上游樓梯或月台，改變原先假設的到達方式。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「電梯服務需求累積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Track shared demand from mobility-limited and luggage-carrying users, retaining those unable to enter the next lift rather than discarding them. A queue accumulates according to inflow minus outflow. Even service capacity slightly above mean demand can be overwhelmed by a train-arrival pulse. People cannot be compressed indefinitely, so a growing queue can block upstream stairs or platforms and alter the assumed arrival process. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Accumulating demand for elevators” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「電梯服務需求累積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Accumulating demand for elevators”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Track shared demand from mobility-limited and luggage-carrying users, retaining those unable to enter the next lift rather than discarding them. A queue accumulates according to inflow minus outflow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「電梯服務需求累積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Accumulating demand for elevators" is correct?
options: 出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
本單元追蹤行動受限者及攜行李旅客的共同需求，保留無法立即進入下一班電梯的人數。
optionsEn: Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Track shared demand from mobility-limited and luggage-carrying users, retaining those unable to enter the next lift rather than discarding them.
quiz.explanation: 本單元追蹤行動受限者及攜行李旅客的共同需求，保留無法立即進入下一班電梯的人數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Track shared demand from mobility-limited and luggage-carrying users, retaining those unable to enter the next lift rather than discarding them. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 電梯服務需求累積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Accumulating demand for elevators: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電梯服務需求累積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Accumulating demand for elevators” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。公式 y=(arrival-service)*duration，代入得 y=72 persons。邊界：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s. Formula y=(arrival-service)*duration gives y=72 persons. Boundary: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。公式 y=(arrival-service)*duration，代入得 y=72 persons。邊界：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。
