steps.title: 受控演練證據安排：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Evidence planning for controlled exercises: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「受控演練證據安排」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Evidence planning for controlled exercises” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「受控演練證據安排」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for evidence planning for controlled exercises. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Trace the input chain for evidence planning for controlled exercises. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「受控演練證據安排」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Evidence planning for controlled exercises" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。

optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort.
The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.

title: 鐵路機廠檢修動線
summary: 本課聚焦機廠資源配置檢修節拍與安全動線。從檢修工位利用率建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把車輛工位狀態管理與檢查面照明分布連成可驗證的介面，最後以維修品質抽樣推論整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies depot resources maintenance cycles and safe movement paths. Start with utilization of maintenance bays to define physical or information boundaries, connect vehicle and bay state management with lighting on inspection surfaces as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through sampling inference for maintenance quality. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究檢修工位利用率。原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=8 jobs/h；單通道服務率 service=12 jobs/h。公式 y=arrival/service，代入得 y=0.666667 1。邊界：固定平均率且單一服務通道；實際批次、優先權與休息中斷須另建模。敏感度只改 arrival=8 至 8.8 jobs/h，輸出變為 0.733333 1；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究車輛移交完整週期：原創假想教學輸入：接車確認 receive=120 s；假想檢查工作 inspect=900 s；工位間移動 move=180 s；驗證交回 handoff=240 s。公式 y=3600/(receive+inspect+move+handoff)，代入得 y=2.5 jobs/h。邊界：單工位無重疊的串行假想作業，未包含備品等待與返工分布。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元將車輛到達需求和可用工位分開，檢查平均利用率相同時尖峰排隊仍可能完全不同。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate utilization of maintenance bays. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=8 jobs/h; single-channel service rate service=12 jobs/h. Formula y=arrival/service gives y=0.666667 1. Boundary: Fixed mean rates and one service channel; batches, priorities and interruptions require separate modelling. For sensitivity, change only arrival=8 to 8.8 jobs/h; the output becomes 0.733333 1. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate complete vehicle-handoff cycle: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: receiving confirmation receive=120 s; hypothetical inspection inspect=900 s; movement between bays move=180 s; verified handoff handoff=240 s. Formula y=3600/(receive+inspect+move+handoff) gives y=2.5 jobs/h. Boundary: Hypothetical non-overlapping serial work in one bay, excluding spares waiting and rework distributions. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Separate vehicle arrival demand from available bays, checking why identical mean utilization can still produce very different peak queues. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 檢修工位利用率與車輛移交完整週期
stages.titleEn: Utilization of maintenance bays & Complete vehicle-handoff cycle
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「檢修工位利用率」與「車輛移交完整週期」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Utilization of maintenance bays" and "Complete vehicle-handoff cycle": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 檢修工位利用率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Utilization of maintenance bays: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「檢修工位利用率」如何影響鐵路機廠檢修動線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Utilization of maintenance bays” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maintenance-depot workflow planning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將車輛到達需求和可用工位分開，檢查平均利用率相同時尖峰排隊仍可能完全不同。利用率比較需求與服務能力，是穩定性檢查而非等待時間的完整答案。平均需求小於平均容量仍可能出現短暫尖峰與排隊；若排程把所有時段填滿，任何變異都只能向後傳播，缺乏讓系統恢復的空間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定平均率且單一服務通道；實際批次、優先權與休息中斷須另建模。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「檢修工位利用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate vehicle arrival demand from available bays, checking why identical mean utilization can still produce very different peak queues. Utilization compares demand with service capacity; it is a stability check rather than a complete waiting-time answer. Mean demand below mean capacity still permits bursts and queues. When every interval is fully occupied, variability propagates downstream because no recovery space remains. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Fixed mean rates and one service channel; batches, priorities and interruptions require separate modelling. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Utilization of maintenance bays” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=8 jobs/h；單通道服務率 service=12 jobs/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=8 jobs/h; single-channel service rate service=12 jobs/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「檢修工位利用率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Utilization of maintenance bays”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 檢修工位利用率
knowledge.text: 本單元將車輛到達需求和可用工位分開，檢查平均利用率相同時尖峰排隊仍可能完全不同。利用率比較需求與服務能力，是穩定性檢查而非等待時間的完整答案。
knowledge.textEn: Separate vehicle arrival demand from available bays, checking why identical mean utilization can still produce very different peak queues. Utilization compares demand with service capacity; it is a stability check rather than a complete waiting-time answer.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「檢修工位利用率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Utilization of maintenance bays" is correct?
options: 平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊
本單元將車輛到達需求和可用工位分開，檢查平均利用率相同時尖峰排隊仍可能完全不同。
檢查工具停止作業就代表整個機廠工位週期已完成
optionsEn: Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms.
Separate vehicle arrival demand from available bays, checking why identical mean utilization can still produce very different peak queues.
The maintenance-bay cycle is complete as soon as inspection tools stop working.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將車輛到達需求和可用工位分開，檢查平均利用率相同時尖峰排隊仍可能完全不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate vehicle arrival demand from available bays, checking why identical mean utilization can still produce very different peak queues. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 檢修工位利用率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Utilization of maintenance bays: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「檢修工位利用率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Utilization of maintenance bays” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=8 jobs/h；單通道服務率 service=12 jobs/h。公式 y=arrival/service，代入得 y=0.666667 1。邊界：固定平均率且單一服務通道；實際批次、優先權與休息中斷須另建模。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=8 jobs/h; single-channel service rate service=12 jobs/h. Formula y=arrival/service gives y=0.666667 1. Boundary: Fixed mean rates and one service channel; batches, priorities and interruptions require separate modelling. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以不同時間窗統計到達與完成數，檢查平均值是否掩蓋短時過載，並保留未完成工作。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Count arrivals and completions over several windows, test for hidden bursts, and retain unfinished work in the accounting.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 檢修工位利用率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Utilization of maintenance bays: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「檢修工位利用率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Utilization of maintenance bays” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以不同時間窗統計到達與完成數，檢查平均值是否掩蓋短時過載，並保留未完成工作。以「檢修工位利用率」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Count arrivals and completions over several windows, test for hidden bursts, and retain unfinished work in the accounting. For utilization of maintenance bays, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把平均到達率 arrival 從 8 改成 8.8 jobs/h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.666667 變為 0.733333 1。先說明「檢修工位利用率」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only mean arrival rate arrival from 8 to 8.8 jobs/h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.666667 to 0.733333 1. Explain the causal direction for utilization of maintenance bays, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 檢修工位利用率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Utilization of maintenance bays: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「檢修工位利用率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Utilization of maintenance bays” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。回到「檢修工位利用率」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. Trace the input chain for utilization of maintenance bays. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定平均率且單一服務通道；實際批次、優先權與休息中斷須另建模。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Fixed mean rates and one service channel; batches, priorities and interruptions require separate modelling.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。回到「檢修工位利用率」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。

Trace the input chain for utilization of maintenance bays. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

The maintenance-bay cycle is complete as soon as inspection tools stop working.

quiz.explanationEn: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 車輛移交完整週期：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Complete vehicle-handoff cycle: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車輛移交完整週期」如何影響鐵路機廠檢修動線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Complete vehicle-handoff cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maintenance-depot workflow planning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把接車、檢查、移動與交回的工作分段，將完整節拍直接對應檢修物流並保留驗證交回時間。檢修物流的完整週期從接車確認開始，到驗證交回才結束，不能只計工具接觸車輛的時間。各階段若串行使用同一資源，其持續時間需要相加；平行工位可改變整體吞吐，但共用移車通道、量測儀器或簽核人員仍可能成為瓶頸，需在資源圖上明確表示。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單工位無重疊的串行假想作業，未包含備品等待與返工分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車輛移交完整週期」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Break receiving, inspection, movement and return into stages, mapping the complete cycle directly to depot logistics and retaining verified handoff time. The maintenance logistics cycle begins at receiving confirmation and ends at verified handoff rather than counting only tool contact. Durations add when stages serially use one resource. Parallel bays can alter throughput, but shared movement paths, instruments or release personnel may remain bottlenecks that must appear explicitly in the resource graph. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Hypothetical non-overlapping serial work in one bay, excluding spares waiting and rework distributions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Complete vehicle-handoff cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：接車確認 receive=120 s；假想檢查工作 inspect=900 s；工位間移動 move=180 s；驗證交回 handoff=240 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: receiving confirmation receive=120 s; hypothetical inspection inspect=900 s; movement between bays move=180 s; verified handoff handoff=240 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「檢查工具停止作業就代表整個機廠工位週期已完成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The maintenance-bay cycle is complete as soon as inspection tools stop working." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

The maintenance logistics cycle begins at receiving confirmation and ends at verified handoff rather than counting only tool contact.

Formula y=3600/(receive+inspect+move+handoff) gives y=2.5 jobs/h. Boundary: Hypothetical non-overlapping serial work in one bay, excluding spares waiting and rework distributions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以工單與獨立事件觀察核對四階段起訖，記錄等待原因和返工次數，避免電子完成時間早於實際移交。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check four stage boundaries using work orders and independent event observation, recording wait causes and reruns so electronic completion cannot precede physical handoff.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：接車確認 receive=120 s；假想檢查工作 inspect=900 s；工位間移動 move=180 s；驗證交回 handoff=240 s。公式 y=3600/(receive+inspect+move+handoff)，代入得 y=2.5 jobs/h。邊界：單工位無重疊的串行假想作業，未包含備品等待與返工分布。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: receiving confirmation receive=120 s; hypothetical inspection inspect=900 s; movement between bays move=180 s; verified handoff handoff=240 s. Formula y=3600/(receive+inspect+move+handoff) gives y=2.5 jobs/h. Boundary: Hypothetical non-overlapping serial work in one bay, excluding spares waiting and rework distributions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「車輛移交完整週期」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Complete vehicle-handoff cycle", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：接車確認 receive=120 s。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: receiving confirmation receive=120 s.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：接車確認 receive=120 s；假想檢查工作 inspect=900 s；工位間移動 move=180 s；驗證交回 handoff=240 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: receiving confirmation receive=120 s; hypothetical inspection inspect=900 s; movement between bays move=180 s; verified handoff handoff=240 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 車輛移交完整週期：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Complete vehicle-handoff cycle: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「車輛移交完整週期」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Complete vehicle-handoff cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以工單與獨立事件觀察核對四階段起訖，記錄等待原因和返工次數，避免電子完成時間早於實際移交。以「車輛移交完整週期」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check four stage boundaries using work orders and independent event observation, recording wait causes and reruns so electronic completion cannot precede physical handoff. For complete vehicle-handoff cycle, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把假想檢查工作 inspect 從 900 改成 990 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.5 變為 2.35294 jobs/h。先說明「車輛移交完整週期」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only hypothetical inspection inspect from 900 to 990 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2.5 to 2.35294 jobs/h. Explain the causal direction for complete vehicle-handoff cycle, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只統計檢查時間會高估工位吞吐，交回前文件缺失可能讓車輛占位卻被系統標示為已完成。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Inspection-only accounting overstates bay throughput; missing release evidence can keep a vehicle occupying a bay after software has labelled the task complete. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以工單與獨立事件觀察核對四階段起訖，記錄等待原因和返工次數，避免電子完成時間早於實際移交。以「車輛移交完整週期」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check four stage boundaries using work orders and independent event observation, recording wait causes and reruns so electronic completion cannot precede physical handoff. For complete vehicle-handoff cycle, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把假想檢查工作 inspect 從 900 改成 990 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.5 變為 2.35294 jobs/h。先說明「車輛移交完整週期」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only hypothetical inspection inspect from 900 to 990 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2.5 to 2.35294 jobs/h. Explain the causal direction for complete vehicle-handoff cycle, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「車輛移交完整週期」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Complete vehicle-handoff cycle"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以工單與獨立事件觀察核對四階段起訖，記錄等待原因和返工次數，避免電子完成時間早於實際移交。
所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Cross-check four stage boundaries using work orders and independent event observation, recording wait causes and reruns so electronic completion cannot precede physical handoff.
All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
quiz.explanation: 以工單與獨立事件觀察核對四階段起訖，記錄等待原因和返工次數，避免電子完成時間早於實際移交。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check four stage boundaries using work orders and independent event observation, recording wait causes and reruns so electronic completion cannot precede physical handoff. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 車輛移交完整週期：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Complete vehicle-handoff cycle: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「車輛移交完整週期」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Complete vehicle-handoff cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只統計檢查時間會高估工位吞吐，交回前文件缺失可能讓車輛占位卻被系統標示為已完成。回到「車輛移交完整週期」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Inspection-only accounting overstates bay throughput; missing release evidence can keep a vehicle occupying a bay after software has labelled the task complete. Trace the input chain for complete vehicle-handoff cycle. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單工位無重疊的串行假想作業，未包含備品等待與返工分布。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Hypothetical non-overlapping serial work in one bay, excluding spares waiting and rework distributions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「檢查工具停止作業就代表整個機廠工位週期已完成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The maintenance-bay cycle is complete as soon as inspection tools stop working." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只統計檢查時間會高估工位吞吐，交回前文件缺失可能讓車輛占位卻被系統標示為已完成。回到「車輛移交完整週期」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Inspection-only accounting overstates bay throughput; missing release evidence can keep a vehicle occupying a bay after software has labelled the task complete. Trace the input chain for complete vehicle-handoff cycle. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「車輛移交完整週期」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Complete vehicle-handoff cycle" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑
只統計檢查時間會高估工位吞吐，交回前文件缺失可能讓車輛占位卻被系統標示為已完成。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
Inspection-only accounting overstates bay throughput; missing release evidence can keep a vehicle occupying a bay after software has labelled the task complete.
quiz.explanation: 只統計檢查時間會高估工位吞吐，交回前文件缺失可能讓車輛占位卻被系統標示為已完成。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspection-only accounting overstates bay throughput; missing release evidence can keep a vehicle occupying a bay after software has labelled the task complete. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 人員與備料路徑與車輛工位狀態管理
stages.titleEn: Staff and material-preparation routes & Vehicle and bay state management
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「人員與備料路徑」與「車輛工位狀態管理」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Staff and material-preparation routes" and "Vehicle and bay state management": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 人員與備料路徑：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Staff and material-preparation routes: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「人員與備料路徑」如何影響鐵路機廠檢修動線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Staff and material-preparation routes” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maintenance-depot workflow planning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元量測人員往返備品區的步行與等待，檢查縮短距離是否造成車輛動線交叉與額外停頓。總旅行時間應同時計入移動與等待，不能只比較平面上的最短距離。坡道、門扇與轉乘決策都可能造成停頓；對行動受限旅客而言，較遠但連續可達的路徑往往比短而不連續的路徑更可用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「人員與備料路徑」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measure staff walking and waiting to reach spares, checking whether a shorter route creates vehicle-path crossings and additional pauses. Travel time includes movement and waiting rather than plan distance alone. Ramps, doors and transfer decisions can introduce pauses. For a mobility-limited traveller, a longer continuously accessible route can be more usable than a shorter route containing an inaccessible interruption. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Staff and material-preparation routes” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「人員與備料路徑」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Staff and material-preparation routes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 人員與備料路徑
knowledge.text: 本單元量測人員往返備品區的步行與等待，檢查縮短距離是否造成車輛動線交叉與額外停頓。總旅行時間應同時計入移動與等待，不能只比較平面上的最短距離。
knowledge.textEn: Measure staff walking and waiting to reach spares, checking whether a shorter route creates vehicle-path crossings and additional pauses. Travel time includes movement and waiting rather than plan distance alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「人員與備料路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Staff and material-preparation routes" is correct?
options: 本單元量測人員往返備品區的步行與等待，檢查縮短距離是否造成車輛動線交叉與額外停頓。
平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
optionsEn: Measure staff walking and waiting to reach spares, checking whether a shorter route creates vehicle-path crossings and additional pauses.
The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
quiz.explanation: 本單元量測人員往返備品區的步行與等待，檢查縮短距離是否造成車輛動線交叉與額外停頓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure staff walking and waiting to reach spares, checking whether a shorter route creates vehicle-path crossings and additional pauses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 人員與備料路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Staff and material-preparation routes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「人員與備料路徑」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Staff and material-preparation routes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=185 s。邊界：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=185 s. Boundary: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

steps.instruction: 用小型模型列舉轉移，再與需求允許的轉移表比較，對被排除狀態留下理由。以「車輛工位狀態管理」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Enumerate transitions in a small model, compare against the required transition table, and document reasons for excluded states. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 車輛工位狀態管理：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Vehicle and bay state management: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「車輛工位狀態管理」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Vehicle and bay state management” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。回到「車輛工位狀態管理」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races. Trace the input chain for vehicle and bay state management. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Trace the input chain for vehicle and bay state management. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「車輛工位狀態管理」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Vehicle and bay state management" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 檢修需求追溯與設備停機與備品等待
stages.titleEn: Tracing maintenance requirements & Equipment outages and spares waiting
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「檢修需求追溯」與「設備停機與備品等待」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tracing maintenance requirements" and "Equipment outages and spares waiting": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 檢修需求追溯：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tracing maintenance requirements: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「檢修需求追溯」如何影響鐵路機廠檢修動線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tracing maintenance requirements” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maintenance-depot workflow planning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將缺陷、工項和驗證紀錄連到同一車輛識別，檢查重複工單是否掩蓋未完成需求。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「檢修需求追溯」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Link defect, work item and verification record to one vehicle identity, checking whether duplicate work orders conceal incomplete requirements. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tracing maintenance requirements” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「檢修需求追溯」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tracing maintenance requirements”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 檢修需求追溯
knowledge.text: 本單元將缺陷、工項和驗證紀錄連到同一車輛識別，檢查重複工單是否掩蓋未完成需求。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。
knowledge.textEn: Link defect, work item and verification record to one vehicle identity, checking whether duplicate work orders conceal incomplete requirements. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「檢修需求追溯」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tracing maintenance requirements" is correct?
options: 測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的

optionsEn: One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
Link defect, work item and verification record to one vehicle identity, checking whether duplicate work orders conceal incomplete requirements.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將缺陷、工項和驗證紀錄連到同一車輛識別，檢查重複工單是否掩蓋未完成需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 檢修需求追溯：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tracing maintenance requirements: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「檢修需求追溯」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tracing maintenance requirements” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tracing maintenance requirements", which statement holds?

每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短

steps.instruction: 本單元分開機具修復和等待備品的時間，讓維修排程能辨認真正造成工位停用的因素。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「設備停機與備品等待」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate repair time from waiting for spares so maintenance planning can identify what actually keeps a bay unavailable. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equipment outages and spares waiting” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality.
quiz.explanation: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 設備停機與備品等待：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Equipment outages and spares waiting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「設備停機與備品等待」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Equipment outages and spares waiting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「設備停機與備品等待」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for equipment outages and spares waiting. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「設備停機與備品等待」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for equipment outages and spares waiting. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「設備停機與備品等待」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Equipment outages and spares waiting" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口
optionsEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
quiz.explanation: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 檢查面照明分布與工單與實體狀態交接
stages.titleEn: Lighting on inspection surfaces & Handoff of work orders and physical state
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「檢查面照明分布」與「工單與實體狀態交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lighting on inspection surfaces" and "Handoff of work orders and physical state": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 檢查面照明分布：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lighting on inspection surfaces: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「檢查面照明分布」如何影響鐵路機廠檢修動線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lighting on inspection surfaces” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maintenance-depot workflow planning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較車底陰影與一般作業面照度，檢查局部視線受阻是否使平均明亮的工位仍難以辨認缺陷。平均照度由到達工作面的光通量除以面積估算，但光學分布決定暗點是否存在。煙氣、污損與電池老化可能同時降低可見性；指示方向、對比與旅客視力也會影響辨識，不能只用燈具是否亮著作為完成檢核。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻平均照度估算，未模擬煙氣散射或法定最低照度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「檢查面照明分布」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare underbody shadows with normal work-surface lighting, checking whether local obstruction makes defects hard to recognize despite a bright bay average. Mean illuminance divides useful luminous flux by area, but optical distribution determines dark spots. Smoke, dirt and battery ageing can reduce visibility together. Directional cues, contrast and eyesight affect recognition, so a lamp being on is not a complete verification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lighting on inspection surfaces” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：光通量 flux=2400 lm；利用係數 util=0.45 1；受照面積 area=24 m2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: luminous flux flux=2400 lm; utilization factor util=0.45 1; illuminated area area=24 m2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「檢查面照明分布」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lighting on inspection surfaces”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 檢查面照明分布
knowledge.text: 本單元比較車底陰影與一般作業面照度，檢查局部視線受阻是否使平均明亮的工位仍難以辨認缺陷。平均照度由到達工作面的光通量除以面積估算，但光學分布決定暗點是否存在。
knowledge.textEn: Compare underbody shadows with normal work-surface lighting, checking whether local obstruction makes defects hard to recognize despite a bright bay average. Mean illuminance divides useful luminous flux by area, but optical distribution determines dark spots.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「檢查面照明分布」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lighting on inspection surfaces" is correct?
options: 照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口
本單元比較車底陰影與一般作業面照度，檢查局部視線受阻是否使平均明亮的工位仍難以辨認缺陷。
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
optionsEn: Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
Compare underbody shadows with normal work-surface lighting, checking whether local obstruction makes defects hard to recognize despite a bright bay average.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
quiz.explanation: 本單元比較車底陰影與一般作業面照度，檢查局部視線受阻是否使平均明亮的工位仍難以辨認缺陷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare underbody shadows with normal work-surface lighting, checking whether local obstruction makes defects hard to recognize despite a bright bay average. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 檢查面照明分布：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lighting on inspection surfaces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「檢查面照明分布」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lighting on inspection surfaces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：光通量 flux=2400 lm；利用係數 util=0.45 1；受照面積 area=24 m2。公式 y=flux*util/area，代入得 y=45 lx。邊界：均勻平均照度估算，未模擬煙氣散射或法定最低照度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: luminous flux flux=2400 lm; utilization factor util=0.45 1; illuminated area area=24 m2. Formula y=flux*util/area gives y=45 lx. Boundary: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以網格量測平面照度並尋找最低點，對照電池放電前後與不同觀看方向。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure illuminance on a grid, identify minima, and compare before/after battery discharge and different viewing directions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：光通量 flux=2400 lm；利用係數 util=0.45 1；受照面積 area=24 m2。公式 y=flux*util/area，代入得 y=45 lx。邊界：均勻平均照度估算，未模擬煙氣散射或法定最低照度。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: luminous flux flux=2400 lm; utilization factor util=0.45 1; illuminated area area=24 m2. Formula y=flux*util/area gives y=45 lx. Boundary: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「檢查面照明分布」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lighting on inspection surfaces", which statement holds?
options: 完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
檢查工具停止作業就代表整個機廠工位週期已完成
原創假想教學輸入：光通量 flux=2400 lm；利用係數 util=0.45 1；受照面積 area=24 m2。
optionsEn: Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
The maintenance-bay cycle is complete as soon as inspection tools stop working.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: luminous flux flux=2400 lm; utilization factor util=0.45 1; illuminated area area=24 m2.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：光通量 flux=2400 lm；利用係數 util=0.45 1；受照面積 area=24 m2。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: luminous flux flux=2400 lm; utilization factor util=0.45 1; illuminated area area=24 m2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 檢查面照明分布：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lighting on inspection surfaces: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「檢查面照明分布」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lighting on inspection surfaces” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以網格量測平面照度並尋找最低點，對照電池放電前後與不同觀看方向。以「檢查面照明分布」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure illuminance on a grid, identify minima, and compare before/after battery discharge and different viewing directions. For lighting on inspection surfaces, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把光通量 flux 從 2400 改成 2640 lm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 45 變為 49.5 lx。先說明「檢查面照明分布」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only luminous flux flux from 2400 to 2640 lm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 45 to 49.5 lx. Explain the causal direction for lighting on inspection surfaces, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：亮度集中在燈具下方可能留下暗區，指示牌反光也可降低遠距離的有效對比。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Light concentrated beneath fixtures leaves dark regions; sign glare can also reduce effective contrast at a distance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以網格量測平面照度並尋找最低點，對照電池放電前後與不同觀看方向。以「檢查面照明分布」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Measure illuminance on a grid, identify minima, and compare before/after battery discharge and different viewing directions. For lighting on inspection surfaces, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把光通量 flux 從 2400 改成 2640 lm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 45 變為 49.5 lx。先說明「檢查面照明分布」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only luminous flux flux from 2400 to 2640 lm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 45 to 49.5 lx. Explain the causal direction for lighting on inspection surfaces, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「檢查面照明分布」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lighting on inspection surfaces"?
options: 以網格量測平面照度並尋找最低點，對照電池放電前後與不同觀看方向。

optionsEn: Measure illuminance on a grid, identify minima, and compare before/after battery discharge and different viewing directions.

Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
quiz.explanation: 以網格量測平面照度並尋找最低點，對照電池放電前後與不同觀看方向。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure illuminance on a grid, identify minima, and compare before/after battery discharge and different viewing directions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 檢查面照明分布：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lighting on inspection surfaces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「檢查面照明分布」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lighting on inspection surfaces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 工單與實體狀態交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Handoff of work orders and physical state: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「工單與實體狀態交接」如何影響鐵路機廠檢修動線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Handoff of work orders and physical state” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maintenance-depot workflow planning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元對齊電子工單更新與實體車輛移交的時間，防止資料已完成但現場尚未完成的版本落差。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「工單與實體狀態交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Align electronic work-order updates with physical vehicle handoff, preventing a completed database entry from concealing unfinished physical work. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Handoff of work orders and physical state” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「工單與實體狀態交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。回到「工單與實體狀態交接」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. Trace the input chain for handoff of work orders and physical state. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「工單與實體狀態交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance.

quiz.explanationEn: Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 檢修驗證工時計畫與維修品質抽樣推論
stages.titleEn: Planning maintenance verification effort & Sampling inference for maintenance quality
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「檢修驗證工時計畫」與「維修品質抽樣推論」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Planning maintenance verification effort" and "Sampling inference for maintenance quality": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 檢修驗證工時計畫：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Planning maintenance verification effort: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「檢修驗證工時計畫」如何影響鐵路機廠檢修動線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Planning maintenance verification effort” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maintenance-depot workflow planning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將檢查、重置、證據保存及缺陷重測納入完整時間，不把計畫工時只等同於首次操作時間。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。平行化只有在資源和狀態真正獨立時有效；把多個會修改同一狀態的測試同時執行，可能造成結果不可重現，表面節省時間卻增加診斷成本。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「檢修驗證工時計畫」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Include inspection, reset, evidence preservation and defect reruns in effort estimates rather than equating planned duration with first-pass operation alone. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling. Parallelism helps only when resources and state are genuinely independent. Concurrent tests modifying one shared state can become irreproducible, apparently saving execution time while increasing diagnostic cost. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Planning maintenance verification effort” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 檢修驗證工時計畫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Planning maintenance verification effort: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「檢修驗證工時計畫」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Planning maintenance verification effort” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。公式 y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60，代入得 y=19 h。邊界：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Formula y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60 gives y=19 h. Boundary: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。以「檢修驗證工時計畫」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 維修品質抽樣推論：機制與系統路徑
