steps.title: 控制紀錄備援續航：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Backup duration for control and logging: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「控制紀錄備援續航」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Backup duration for control and logging” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測完整負載曲線與最低端電壓，分別核對連續能量及啟動瞬間壓降。以「控制紀錄備援續航」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the load profile and minimum terminal voltage, checking continuous energy and startup sag separately. For backup duration for control and logging, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把固定負載 load 從 350 改成 385 W（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3.84 變為 3.49091 h。先說明「控制紀錄備援續航」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only constant load load from 350 to 385 W (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 3.84 to 3.49091 h. Explain the causal direction for backup duration for control and logging, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：老化電池可能保有部分容量但內阻升高，啟動負載時掉壓使設備提早中止。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An aged battery may retain some capacity while internal resistance rises, causing early shutdown during a starting load. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 控制紀錄備援續航：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Backup duration for control and logging: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「控制紀錄備援續航」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Backup duration for control and logging” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 老化電池可能保有部分容量但內阻升高，啟動負載時掉壓使設備提早中止。回到「控制紀錄備援續航」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An aged battery may retain some capacity while internal resistance rises, causing early shutdown during a starting load. Trace the input chain for backup duration for control and logging. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定電壓定負載近似，未含電池非線性放電與溫度效應。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要安培小時數相同任何兩種電池續航就一定相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal ampere-hour ratings guarantee equal runtime for any two batteries." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「控制紀錄備援續航」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
An aged battery may retain some capacity while internal resistance rises, causing early shutdown during a starting load.

stages.title: 車型與中止情境矩陣與洗車服務與維修配置
stages.titleEn: Vehicle-profile and interruption test matrix & Washing service and maintenance allocation
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「車型與中止情境矩陣」與「洗車服務與維修配置」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Vehicle-profile and interruption test matrix" and "Washing service and maintenance allocation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 車型與中止情境矩陣：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Vehicle-profile and interruption test matrix: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車型與中止情境矩陣」如何影響列車自動洗車機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vehicle-profile and interruption test matrix” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train-washing plants”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把不同車頭外形、感測失效與洗程中止列成分開案例，不以多次同車試洗取代型式覆蓋。核對每案的設備狀態與復原證據，留下未驗證的條件。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車型與中止情境矩陣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: List distinct cases for vehicle profiles, sensing failures and interrupted cycles rather than repeating one vehicle as a substitute for coverage. Check state and recovery evidence and retain untested conditions explicitly. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Vehicle-profile and interruption test matrix” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「車型與中止情境矩陣」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Vehicle-profile and interruption test matrix” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「車型與中止情境矩陣」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. steps.title: 車型與中止情境矩陣：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Vehicle-profile and interruption test matrix: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「車型與中止情境矩陣」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Vehicle-profile and interruption test matrix” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「車型與中止情境矩陣」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for vehicle-profile and interruption test matrix. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 洗車服務與維修配置：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Washing service and maintenance allocation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「洗車服務與維修配置」如何影響列車自動洗車機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Washing service and maintenance allocation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train-washing plants”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 區分可洗車、降級服務和完全停機，維修履歷才不會高估可用時間。再比較頻繁短停與罕見長停如何影響回廠列車排隊，保留相同可用度下的差異。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洗車服務與維修配置」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish full service, degraded washing and complete shutdown to avoid overstated availability. Compare how frequent brief stops and rare long outages affect returning-train queues despite equal long-run availability. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Washing service and maintenance allocation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「洗車服務與維修配置」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Washing service and maintenance allocation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Distinguish full service, degraded washing and complete shutdown to avoid overstated availability. Compare how frequent brief stops and rare long outages affect returning-train queues despite equal long-run availability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 洗車服務與維修配置：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「洗車服務與維修配置」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Washing service and maintenance allocation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「洗車服務與維修配置」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Washing service and maintenance allocation"?

steps.title: 洗車服務與維修配置：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Washing service and maintenance allocation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「洗車服務與維修配置」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Washing service and maintenance allocation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「洗車服務與維修配置」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for washing service and maintenance allocation. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「洗車服務與維修配置」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for washing service and maintenance allocation. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「洗車服務與維修配置」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Washing service and maintenance allocation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。
回收比例越高就能保證清洗效果一定越好
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency.
A higher recycling fraction always guarantees better cleaning performance.

quiz.explanationEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 貨運編組場駝峰調速
summary: 本課聚焦以能量與事件時序理解貨運駝峰調速。從坡高與重力能量帳建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把速度資料年齡與位移與區段軸數與未知狀態連成可驗證的介面，最後以載重與環境試驗邊界整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies energy accounting and event timing in hump-yard speed control. Start with height drop and gravitational energy to define physical or information boundaries, connect data age and continued wagon movement with section axle balance and unknown state as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through load and environment coverage. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究坡高與重力能量帳。原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；下降高度 h=1.2 m。公式 y=m*g*h/1000，代入得 y=824.04 kJ。邊界：重力位能帳，未計真實場站阻力、風與調速設備控制。敏感度只改 h=1.2 至 1.32 m，輸出變為 906.444 kJ；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究動能差與平均耗能力：原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；初速 v0=5 m/s；末速 v1=2 m/s；耗能距離 length=18 m。公式 y=0.5*m*(v0*v0-v1*v1)/length/1000，代入得 y=40.8333 kN。邊界：平直路徑與定等效耗能，不包含實際編組場操作參數。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。先畫出車輛質心高度的起訖位置，將可用位能與沿途阻力損失分開。比較不同質量的原創案例，避免只用坡高猜測到達速度。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate height drop and gravitational energy. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; vertical drop h=1.2 m. Formula y=m*g*h/1000 gives y=824.04 kJ. Boundary: Gravitational energy accounting without real yard resistance, wind or retarder control. For sensitivity, change only h=1.2 to 1.32 m; the output becomes 906.444 kJ. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; initial speed v0=5 m/s; final speed v1=2 m/s; dissipation distance length=18 m. Formula y=0.5*m*(v0*v0-v1*v1)/length/1000 gives y=40.8333 kN. Boundary: Level path and constant equivalent dissipation, without real hump-yard operating settings. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Mark initial and final centre-of-mass heights and separate available potential energy from losses along the route. Compare hypothetical wagon masses without predicting arrival speed from height alone. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 坡高與重力能量帳與動能差與平均耗能力
stages.titleEn: Height drop and gravitational energy & Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「坡高與重力能量帳」與「動能差與平均耗能力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Height drop and gravitational energy" and "Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 坡高與重力能量帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Height drop and gravitational energy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「坡高與重力能量帳」如何影響貨運編組場駝峰調速的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Height drop and gravitational energy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hump-yard speed-control systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先畫出車輛質心高度的起訖位置，將可用位能與沿途阻力損失分開。比較不同質量的原創案例，避免只用坡高猜測到達速度。位能下降可轉成動能與耗散，質量同時影響可用能量和需要消散的能量。駝峰調速的速度結果還受滾動阻力、風與車輛狀態影響；只用高度差決定目標速度會漏掉路徑上的持續損失與偶發阻力。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：重力位能帳，未計真實場站阻力、風與調速設備控制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡高與重力能量帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mark initial and final centre-of-mass heights and separate available potential energy from losses along the route. Compare hypothetical wagon masses without predicting arrival speed from height alone. Lost gravitational energy becomes kinetic energy and dissipation. Mass affects both available and required dissipated energy. Hump-yard speed also depends on rolling resistance, wind and vehicle condition. Height drop alone cannot determine final speed without accounting for losses along the path. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Gravitational energy accounting without real yard resistance, wind or retarder control. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Height drop and gravitational energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；下降高度 h=1.2 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; vertical drop h=1.2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「下降高度一樣就能保證所有貨車得到相同末速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal height drop guarantees equal final speed for all freight wagons." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「坡高與重力能量帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Height drop and gravitational energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 坡高與重力能量帳
knowledge.text: 先畫出車輛質心高度的起訖位置，將可用位能與沿途阻力損失分開。比較不同質量的原創案例，避免只用坡高猜測到達速度。
knowledge.textEn: Mark initial and final centre-of-mass heights and separate available potential energy from losses along the route. Compare hypothetical wagon masses without predicting arrival speed from height alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：下降高度一樣就能保證所有貨車得到相同末速度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal height drop guarantees equal final speed for all freight wagons. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「坡高與重力能量帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Height drop and gravitational energy" is correct?
options: 下降高度一樣就能保證所有貨車得到相同末速度
先畫出車輛質心高度的起訖位置，將可用位能與沿途阻力損失分開。
耗能設備平均力相同就能保證所有進入速度的末速相同
optionsEn: Equal height drop guarantees equal final speed for all freight wagons.
Mark initial and final centre-of-mass heights and separate available potential energy from losses along the route.
Equal mean retarding force gives the same exit speed for every entry speed.
quiz.explanation: 先畫出車輛質心高度的起訖位置，將可用位能與沿途阻力損失分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mark initial and final centre-of-mass heights and separate available potential energy from losses along the route. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 坡高與重力能量帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Height drop and gravitational energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「坡高與重力能量帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Height drop and gravitational energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；下降高度 h=1.2 m。公式 y=m*g*h/1000，代入得 y=824.04 kJ。邊界：重力位能帳，未計真實場站阻力、風與調速設備控制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; vertical drop h=1.2 m. Formula y=m*g*h/1000 gives y=824.04 kJ. Boundary: Gravitational energy accounting without real yard resistance, wind or retarder control. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以縮尺斜面比較同高度與不同阻力表面的末速，記錄能量差而非只看是否滑動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a scale incline to compare final speeds at equal drop but different resistance, recording the energy difference rather than merely motion.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；下降高度 h=1.2 m。公式 y=m*g*h/1000，代入得 y=824.04 kJ。邊界：重力位能帳，未計真實場站阻力、風與調速設備控制。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; vertical drop h=1.2 m. Formula y=m*g*h/1000 gives y=824.04 kJ. Boundary: Gravitational energy accounting without real yard resistance, wind or retarder control.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 坡高與重力能量帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Height drop and gravitational energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「坡高與重力能量帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Height drop and gravitational energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以縮尺斜面比較同高度與不同阻力表面的末速，記錄能量差而非只看是否滑動。以「坡高與重力能量帳」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a scale incline to compare final speeds at equal drop but different resistance, recording the energy difference rather than merely motion. For height drop and gravitational energy, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把下降高度 h 從 1.2 改成 1.32 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 824.04 變為 906.444 kJ。先說明「坡高與重力能量帳」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only vertical drop h from 1.2 to 1.32 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 824.04 to 906.444 kJ. Explain the causal direction for height drop and gravitational energy, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：低阻車輛可能比預測更快，輪軸阻力增加則可能停在途中，兩者都不能靠平均車重辨認。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Height drop and gravitational energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 低阻車輛可能比預測更快，輪軸阻力增加則可能停在途中，兩者都不能靠平均車重辨認。回到「坡高與重力能量帳」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A low-resistance wagon can exceed the predicted speed, while increased bearing resistance can stop it early; average mass cannot distinguish either condition. Trace the input chain for height drop and gravitational energy. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：重力位能帳，未計真實場站阻力、風與調速設備控制。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 動能差與平均耗能力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「動能差與平均耗能力」如何影響貨運編組場駝峰調速的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hump-yard speed-control systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把入口與出口速度各自平方後建立能量差，觀察入口速度小幅偏差的放大效果。再把平均力與沿程峰值區分，不能從一個平均量推論接觸力分布。所需平均耗能力可由動能差除以作用距離估算，初速平方使高速偏差特別敏感。平均力不是峰值力，也不會描述濕滑、延遲和接觸分布；調速結果必須同時檢查能量帳、末速與沿程減速度。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路徑與定等效耗能，不包含實際編組場操作參數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「動能差與平均耗能力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use squared entry and exit speeds to obtain the energy change and observe sensitivity to entry-speed error. Distinguish mean force from local peaks instead of inferring the contact distribution from one average. Required mean dissipating force follows kinetic-energy change divided by distance, making high initial-speed errors particularly influential. Mean force is not peak force and does not describe wet contact, delay or force distribution. Verification needs energy, exit speed and deceleration along the path together. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level path and constant equivalent dissipation, without real hump-yard operating settings. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；初速 v0=5 m/s；末速 v1=2 m/s；耗能距離 length=18 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; initial speed v0=5 m/s; final speed v1=2 m/s; dissipation distance length=18 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「耗能設備平均力相同就能保證所有進入速度的末速相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal mean retarding force gives the same exit speed for every entry speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「動能差與平均耗能力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 動能差與平均耗能力

knowledge.textEn: Use squared entry and exit speeds to obtain the energy change and observe sensitivity to entry-speed error. Distinguish mean force from local peaks instead of inferring the contact distribution from one average.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：耗能設備平均力相同就能保證所有進入速度的末速相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal mean retarding force gives the same exit speed for every entry speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「動能差與平均耗能力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force" is correct?
options: 耗能設備平均力相同就能保證所有進入速度的末速相同
感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度

optionsEn: Equal mean retarding force gives the same exit speed for every entry speed.
Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed.
Use squared entry and exit speeds to obtain the energy change and observe sensitivity to entry-speed error.
quiz.explanation: 把入口與出口速度各自平方後建立能量差，觀察入口速度小幅偏差的放大效果。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 動能差與平均耗能力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「動能差與平均耗能力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；初速 v0=5 m/s；末速 v1=2 m/s；耗能距離 length=18 m。公式 y=0.5*m*(v0*v0-v1*v1)/length/1000，代入得 y=40.8333 kN。邊界：平直路徑與定等效耗能，不包含實際編組場操作參數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; initial speed v0=5 m/s; final speed v1=2 m/s; dissipation distance length=18 m. Formula y=0.5*m*(v0*v0-v1*v1)/length/1000 gives y=40.8333 kN. Boundary: Level path and constant equivalent dissipation, without real hump-yard operating settings. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在離線模型比較能量積分與末速度，將接觸延遲及作用長度誤差各自改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In an offline model, compare integrated energy with exit speed and vary contact delay and effective length independently.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 在離線模型比較能量積分與末速度，將接觸延遲及作用長度誤差各自改變。以「動能差與平均耗能力」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In an offline model, compare integrated energy with exit speed and vary contact delay and effective length independently. steps.observation: 現場實務：只把初速 v0 從 5 改成 5.5 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 40.8333 變為 51.0417 kN。先說明「動能差與平均耗能力」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pairing events for local speed" and "Data age and continued wagon movement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 局部速度事件配對：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pairing events for local speed: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「局部速度事件配對」如何影響貨運編組場駝峰調速的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pairing events for local speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hump-yard speed-control systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩測點必須對應同一輪對，否則除出來的速度可能形式正確卻沒有物理意義。以模型車往返重播檢查配對和方向，保留接近停車時的模糊情況。兩個相鄰感測點的事件先後順序可提供方向，間距除以時間差可估局部速度。時間解析度與輪緣幾何都影響結果；接近停車或往返擺動時，事件配對比公式本身更容易出錯。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「局部速度事件配對」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Both detector events must correspond to the same wheelset or the computed speed has no physical meaning. Replay a model wagon in both directions and retain ambiguous near-standstill cases. Event ordering across two nearby sensors provides direction, while separation divided by transit time estimates local speed. Timing resolution and wheel geometry affect the estimate. Near standstill or during oscillatory movement, pairing the correct events is often harder than evaluating the equation. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pairing events for local speed” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instruction: 時鐘偏移會偽裝成網路延遲，重設時間戳又可能隱藏陳舊資料，需用獨立時間基準辨認。回到「速度資料年齡與位移」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

stages.title: 輪周距離與地面行程與反應段與耗能段邊界

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wheel travel versus ground displacement" and "Response and deceleration boundaries": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輪周距離與地面行程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wheel travel versus ground displacement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「輪周距離與地面行程」如何影響貨運編組場駝峰調速的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wheel travel versus ground displacement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hump-yard speed-control systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以獨立地標比較輪周累積距離，分離比例誤差和固定零點偏移。遇到滑移或不同輪徑時先質疑換算前提，不把平順數值當成真實位置證據。輪徑與脈衝換算比例的誤差會隨行走距離累積，固定零點偏差則不隨距離放大。輪滑與空轉使輪周距離不等於地面位移；定期地標校正能約束累積誤差，但地標本身的位置與辨識可信度仍須驗證。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輪周距離與地面行程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare accumulated wheel travel with independent landmarks, separating scale error from zero offset. Question conversion assumptions under slip or changing wheel diameter rather than treating a smooth reading as ground truth. Wheel diameter and pulse-scale error accumulate with distance, whereas a fixed zero offset does not grow. Slip makes wheel travel differ from ground displacement. Landmark updates can constrain drift, but the landmark position and identification credibility still require verification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wheel travel versus ground displacement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「短距離校正準確就能保證長距離里程也完全準確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Accurate short-distance calibration guarantees perfectly accurate long-distance odometry." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「輪周距離與地面行程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wheel travel versus ground displacement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 以獨立地標比較輪周累積距離，分離比例誤差和固定零點偏移。遇到滑移或不同輪徑時先質疑換算前提，不把平順數值當成真實位置證據。

steps.title: 輪周距離與地面行程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wheel travel versus ground displacement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輪周距離與地面行程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wheel travel versus ground displacement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。公式 y=distance*scale+bias，代入得 y=6.2 m。邊界：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m. Formula y=distance*scale+bias gives y=6.2 m. Boundary: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在多個已知距離區段繪製殘差對距離，利用斜率與截距分別估計比例及零點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot residual against several known travel distances and use slope and intercept to separate scale and zero-offset effects.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 在多個已知距離區段繪製殘差對距離，利用斜率與截距分別估計比例及零點。以「輪周距離與地面行程」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。

耗能設備平均力相同就能保證所有進入速度的末速相同
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Plot residual against several known travel distances and use slope and intercept to separate scale and zero-offset effects.
Equal mean retarding force gives the same exit speed for every entry speed.
quiz.explanation: 在多個已知距離區段繪製殘差對距離，利用斜率與截距分別估計比例及零點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot residual against several known travel distances and use slope and intercept to separate scale and zero-offset effects. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 輪周距離與地面行程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wheel travel versus ground displacement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輪周距離與地面行程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wheel travel versus ground displacement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一次短距離校正可能掩蓋比例誤差，輪滑事件則在殘差曲線留下突跳而非固定斜率。回到「輪周距離與地面行程」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A short calibration run can hide scale error; slip events cause residual jumps rather than a constant slope. Trace the input chain for wheel travel versus ground displacement. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「短距離校正準確就能保證長距離里程也完全準確」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Accurate short-distance calibration guarantees perfectly accurate long-distance odometry." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一次短距離校正可能掩蓋比例誤差，輪滑事件則在殘差曲線留下突跳而非固定斜率。回到「輪周距離與地面行程」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: A short calibration run can hide scale error; slip events cause residual jumps rather than a constant slope. Trace the input chain for wheel travel versus ground displacement. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輪周距離與地面行程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wheel travel versus ground displacement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成
一次短距離校正可能掩蓋比例誤差，輪滑事件則在殘差曲線留下突跳而非固定斜率。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent.
A short calibration run can hide scale error; slip events cause residual jumps rather than a constant slope.
quiz.explanation: 一次短距離校正可能掩蓋比例誤差，輪滑事件則在殘差曲線留下突跳而非固定斜率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A short calibration run can hide scale error; slip events cause residual jumps rather than a constant slope. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 反應段與耗能段邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Response and deceleration boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反應段與耗能段邊界」如何影響貨運編組場駝峰調速的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Response and deceleration boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hump-yard speed-control systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 使用平直教學路段分開反應位移與定減速度位移，作為能量模型的交叉檢查。清楚標示此模型沒有坡道或變動調速力，不能替代真實駝峰控制曲線。停止距離由反應期間的等速前進與制動期間的動能消散相加。速度增加會同時增加兩項，而減速度只影響第二項；把控制命令發出時間當成制動力建立時間會漏掉一段距離。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反應段與耗能段邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate response travel and constant-deceleration travel on a level teaching segment as an energy-model cross-check. State that gradients and variable retarding forces are absent, so this is not a real yard-control curve. Stopping distance combines constant-speed travel during response with kinetic-energy removal during braking. Speed changes both contributions, whereas deceleration changes only the second. A command timestamp is not the instant at which the full braking force becomes available. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Response and deceleration boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「反應段與耗能段邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Response and deceleration boundaries”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 反應段與耗能段邊界
knowledge.text: 使用平直教學路段分開反應位移與定減速度位移，作為能量模型的交叉檢查。清楚標示此模型沒有坡道或變動調速力，不能替代真實駝峰控制曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Separate response travel and constant-deceleration travel on a level teaching segment as an energy-model cross-check. State that gradients and variable retarding forces are absent, so this is not a real yard-control curve.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「反應段與耗能段邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Response and deceleration boundaries" is correct?
options: 使用平直教學路段分開反應位移與定減速度位移，作為能量模型的交叉檢查。
速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成
進出計數剛好相同就能無條件證明區段無車
optionsEn: Separate response travel and constant-deceleration travel on a level teaching segment as an energy-model cross-check.
Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent.
Equal entry and exit counts unconditionally prove that a section is empty.
quiz.explanation: 使用平直教學路段分開反應位移與定減速度位移，作為能量模型的交叉檢查。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate response travel and constant-deceleration travel on a level teaching segment as an energy-model cross-check. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 反應段與耗能段邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Response and deceleration boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反應段與耗能段邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Response and deceleration boundaries” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「反應段與耗能段邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Response and deceleration boundaries", which statement holds?
options: 狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。
下降高度一樣就能保證所有貨車得到相同末速度
optionsEn: Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s.
Equal height drop guarantees equal final speed for all freight wagons.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 反應段與耗能段邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Response and deceleration boundaries: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反應段與耗能段邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Response and deceleration boundaries” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。以「反應段與耗能段邊界」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement. For response and deceleration boundaries, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把初速 v 從 20 改成 22 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 280 變為 335.5 m。先說明「反應段與耗能段邊界」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only initial speed v from 20 to 22 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 280 to 335.5 m. Explain the causal direction for response and deceleration boundaries, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Weak deceleration and delayed response both cause an overrun, but the onset of the speed-curve change distinguishes these causes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。以「反應段與耗能段邊界」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement. For response and deceleration boundaries, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把初速 v 從 20 改成 22 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 280 變為 335.5 m。先說明「反應段與耗能段邊界」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only initial speed v from 20 to 22 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 280 to 335.5 m. Explain the causal direction for response and deceleration boundaries, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「反應段與耗能段邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Response and deceleration boundaries"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度
以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed.
Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement.
quiz.explanation: 以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 反應段與耗能段邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Response and deceleration boundaries: failure diagnosis

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Response and deceleration boundaries” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。回到「反應段與耗能段邊界」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 區段軸數與未知狀態：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Section axle balance and unknown state” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hump-yard speed-control systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 區段進出軸數守恆只提供占用約束，不能告訴控制器車輛精確停在哪裡。將漏計、回滾和人工真值分開比較，零差值仍須具有可信的事件紀錄。計軸占用利用邊界流入與流出守恆，計數差不是列車位置量測。差值為零仍需邊界感測器、方向判斷與狀態可信度成立；未知或故障狀態不能僅因兩個數字相等就自動宣告清空。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「區段軸數與未知狀態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Boundary axle balance constrains occupancy but does not locate a wagon precisely. Compare missed counts, rollback and independent truth separately; a zero balance still requires trustworthy event records. Axle counting applies conservation at section boundaries; the count difference is not a position measurement. A zero difference is useful only when boundary sensing, direction and state validity are trustworthy. Unknown or failed states cannot be declared clear merely because two numbers match. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Section axle balance and unknown state” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：進入軸數 enter=48 axles；離開軸數 leave=44 axles。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：進入軸數 enter=48 axles；離開軸數 leave=44 axles。公式 y=enter-leave，代入得 y=4 axles。邊界：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles. Formula y=enter-leave gives y=4 axles. Boundary: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以標記輪對的玩具車雙向重播，對照人工真值、事件順序與感測器有效旗標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Replay a marked model vehicle in both directions and compare manual truth, event ordering and sensor-validity flags.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 調速事件共同時基：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Common timebase for speed-control events: mechanism and system paths

steps.instruction: 把入口偵測、控制回報與出口量測放到同一時間線，先排除各儀器時鐘差。再檢查長時間漂移，避免把紀錄錯序誤判為機構先後反應異常。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「調速事件共同時基」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Place entry detection, controller reports and exit measurement on one timeline after accounting for clock offsets. Check longer-term drift before interpreting reordered records as a mechanical timing fault. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Common timebase for speed-control events” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 調速事件共同時基：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「調速事件共同時基」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

stages.title: 車組任務與路徑狀態與載重與環境試驗邊界
stages.titleEn: Wagon-group assignments and route states & Load and environment coverage
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「車組任務與路徑狀態」與「載重與環境試驗邊界」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wagon-group assignments and route states" and "Load and environment coverage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 車組任務與路徑狀態：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wagon-group assignments and route states: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車組任務與路徑狀態」如何影響貨運編組場駝峰調速的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wagon-group assignments and route states” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hump-yard speed-control systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分開車組辨識、路徑保留和設備可用狀態，避免一個正常旗標代表全部條件。用小型離線狀態圖找出互斥任務和循環等待，不重製現場控制邏輯。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車組任務與路徑狀態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate wagon identification, route reservation and equipment availability rather than treating one normal flag as universal readiness. Use a small offline state graph to detect incompatible assignments and circular waits without reproducing field logic. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wagon-group assignments and route states” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「車組任務與路徑狀態」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wagon-group assignments and route states”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 車組任務與路徑狀態

knowledge.textEn: Separate wagon identification, route reservation and equipment availability rather than treating one normal flag as universal readiness. Use a small offline state graph to detect incompatible assignments and circular waits without reproducing field logic.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「車組任務與路徑狀態」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wagon-group assignments and route states" is correct?

optionsEn: Separate wagon identification, route reservation and equipment availability rather than treating one normal flag as universal readiness.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.

steps.title: 車組任務與路徑狀態：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wagon-group assignments and route states: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「車組任務與路徑狀態」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wagon-group assignments and route states” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。公式 y=2**bits，代入得 y=256 states。邊界：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits. Formula y=2**bits gives y=256 states. Boundary: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用小型模型列舉轉移，再與需求允許的轉移表比較，對被排除狀態留下理由。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Enumerate transitions in a small model, compare against the required transition table, and document reasons for excluded states.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。公式 y=2**bits，代入得 y=256 states。邊界：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「車組任務與路徑狀態」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 耗能設備平均力相同就能保證所有進入速度的末速相同

封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置

Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits.
A newly received packet always contains the present position.
