steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Load delivered to treatment: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「送往處理廠污染帳」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at load delivered to treatment.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.

steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「送往處理廠污染帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. steps.title: 沿線液位同步：感測器偏移校正：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 沿線液位同步：感測器偏移校正 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Distributed level synchronization: Sensor offset calibration and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「沿線液位同步」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at distributed level synchronization.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
steps.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「沿線液位同步」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for distributed level synchronization; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instruction: 平行備援可降低獨立停機造成的服務中斷，但共同電源、進水或控制器會破壞獨立假設。本單元在「截流系統備援」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Parallel redundancy reduces outages from independent failures, but common power, feed or controllers invalidate independence. Examine this relationship at interception-system redundancy.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：兩列各自可用率A=0.95且任一列足以供應示範負載。公式 Asys=1-(1-A)^2；代入 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction。適用邊界：僅兩列獨立且容量足夠；不含共同失效或修復時間分布。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: two trains each have availabilityA=0.95 and either meets the hypothetical load. steps.checkEn: Draw a fault tree marking shared assets and replay the process with one train unavailable. Build an offline evidence table for interception-system redundancy; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.textEn: A shared critical valve can stop both trains together. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先點選「截流系統備援」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把各列A改成0.90，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.99 fraction。與基準 0.9975 fraction比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the interception-system redundancy measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only each train availability to0.90 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.99 fraction. Compare with baseline 0.9975 fraction and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: rainP=30 mm, catchmentA=10000 m² andC=0.75. Formula V=CPA/1000; substitution 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³. Boundary: Event-volume approximation; does not predict peak flow or pipe capacity.

title: 芝加哥深隧道與水庫計畫
summary: TARP展示如何把暴雨期間的混合水暫存，於能力允許時送回處理。學徒需建立前一場雨尚未排空的連續事件情境。
summaryEn: TARP illustrates storing combined flows during storms and returning them for treatment when capacity permits. The learner must model consecutive events before storage has emptied.

steps.title: 服務集水區降雨：集水面積與逕流量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Service-catchment rainfall: Catchment area and runoff volume: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 服務集水區降雨：集水面積與逕流量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Service-catchment rainfall: Catchment area and runoff volume and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 降雨量乘面積提供總水量，以逕流係數近似扣除入滲與其他損失；該係數隨土壤與前期濕度而變。本單元在「服務集水區降雨」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Rain depth times area gives total water; a runoff coefficient approximates infiltration and other losses and varies with soil and antecedent moisture. Examine this relationship at service-catchment rainfall.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: rainP=30 mm, catchmentA=10000 m² andC=0.75. Formula V=CPA/1000; substitution 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³. Boundary: Event-volume approximation; does not predict peak flow or pipe capacity.
steps.failure: 把mm直接乘m²而未除1000會造成千倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying mm bym² without dividing by1000 gives a thousandfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 畫屋頂、路面與綠地分區，分別加權C並核對雨量站。在離線場景為「服務集水區降雨」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Map roofs, pavement and vegetation, weight C separately and check rainfall data. Build an offline evidence table for service-catchment rainfall; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 隧道水庫共同儲量：調蓄與連續方程：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Combined tunnel/reservoir storage: Storage and continuity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 隧道水庫共同儲量：調蓄與連續方程 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Combined tunnel/reservoir storage: Storage and continuity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 調蓄量隨入流減出流累積；容積夠大仍須確認退水能力，否則下一場雨開始時未必為空。本單元在「隧道水庫共同儲量」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Storage accumulates inflow minus outflow; sufficient geometric volume is not enough if drawdown leaves it occupied before the next storm. Examine this relationship at combined tunnel/reservoir storage.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：一小時內 Qin=2.0 m³/s、Qout=0.6 m³/s。公式 ΔV=(Qin-Qout)Δt；代入 (2.0-0.6)*3600 = 5040 m³。適用邊界：矩形單一歷線且無滲漏；真實設計必須積分完整降雨歷線。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: over one hour Qin=2.0 m³/s and Qout=0.6 m³/s. Formula ΔV=(Qin-Qout)Δt; substitution (2.0-0.6)*3600 = 5040 m³. Boundary: One rectangular hydrograph without leakage; real design must integrate the full event hydrograph.
steps.failure: 水位計零點漂移會看似增加儲量，需獨立水尺確認。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。

steps.title: 回送污水處理：提升水頭與電力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Return pumping to treatment: Lift head and electrical power: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 回送污水處理：提升水頭與電力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Return pumping to treatment: Lift head and electrical power and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 泵的輸入功率須供應流量的位能增加及損失；效率下降會使同一輸送服務耗電增加。本單元在「回送污水處理」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pump input must provide the hydraulic energy increase and losses; lower efficiency increases electricity for the same conveyance service. Examine this relationship at return pumping to treatment.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=0.10 m³/s、H=12 m、總效率η=0.72、ρ=1000 kg/m³。公式 P=ρgQH/(1000η)；代入 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW。適用邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，H含管損；不涵蓋起動、水錘與汽蝕。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=0.10 m³/s, H=12 m, total efficiencyη=0.72 and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Formula P=ρgQH/(1000η); substitution 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW. Boundary: Steady incompressible flow with friction included in H; starting, surge and cavitation are excluded.
steps.failure: 葉輪磨損或閥門節流會改變工作點，須查泵曲線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Impeller wear or throttling changes the operating point; inspect the pump curve. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「回送污水處理」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for return pumping to treatment; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 調蓄污染質量：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Stored pollutant mass: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 調蓄污染質量：污染負荷與採樣邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Stored pollutant mass: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「調蓄污染質量」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at stored pollutant mass.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
steps.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「調蓄污染質量」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for stored pollutant mass; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 庫內沉積觀察：表面溢流率與沉降分離：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Reservoir sedimentation observation: Surface loading and settling separation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 庫內沉積觀察：表面溢流率與沉降分離 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Reservoir sedimentation observation: Surface loading and settling separation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 理想沉澱中顆粒沉速相對於表面溢流率決定是否捕集；增加深度主要改變停留與污泥儲存，不能取代表面積。本單元在「庫內沉積觀察」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: In ideal settling, particle settling speed relative to surface overflow rate governs capture; greater depth changes retention and sludge storage but cannot replace surface area. Examine this relationship at reservoir sedimentation observation.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=6000 m³/d、表面積 A=300 m²。公式 v0=Q/A；代入 6000/300 = 20 m/d。適用邊界：理想離散顆粒近似；絮凝、污泥濃縮、風與短流另行檢核。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=6000 m³/d and surface area A=300 m². Formula v0=Q/A; substitution 6000/300 = 20 m/d. Boundary: Ideal discrete-particle approximation; flocculation, thickening, wind and short-circuiting need separate checks.
steps.failure: 排泥不良會讓泥層抬升，造成出水固體增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Poor sludge withdrawal raises the sludge blanket and increases effluent solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用沉降柱與進出水SS比對捕集，不把水清澈當溶解物已去除。在離線場景為「庫內沉積觀察」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Compare a settling-column test and inlet/outlet SS; clear water does not prove dissolved contaminants were removed. Build an offline evidence table for reservoir sedimentation observation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 暴雨中泵組退出：備援與共同失效：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 暴雨中泵組退出：備援與共同失效 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Pump unavailability during storms: Redundancy and common failures and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 平行備援可降低獨立停機造成的服務中斷，但共同電源、進水或控制器會破壞獨立假設。本單元在「暴雨中泵組退出」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Parallel redundancy reduces outages from independent failures, but common power, feed or controllers invalidate independence. Examine this relationship at pump unavailability during storms.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：兩列各自可用率A=0.95且任一列足以供應示範負載。公式 Asys=1-(1-A)^2；代入 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction。適用邊界：僅兩列獨立且容量足夠；不含共同失效或修復時間分布。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: two trains each have availabilityA=0.95 and either meets the hypothetical load. Formula Asys=1-(1-A)^2; substitution 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction. Boundary: Two independent adequate-capacity trains only; common failures and repair-time distributions are excluded.
steps.failure: 兩列共用一個關鍵閥門，該閥失效仍會同時停產。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: A shared critical valve can stop both trains together. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 畫故障樹並標出共享設備，測試單列退出時的完整流程。在離線場景為「暴雨中泵組退出」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Draw a fault tree marking shared assets and replay the process with one train unavailable. Build an offline evidence table for pump unavailability during storms; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: rainP=30 mm, catchmentA=10000 m² andC=0.75. Formula V=CPA/1000; substitution 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³. Boundary: Event-volume approximation; does not predict peak flow or pipe capacity.

title: 維也納污水處理能源自給計畫

steps.title: 進廠有機碳入口：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Incoming organic-carbon boundary: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 進廠有機碳入口：污染負荷與採樣邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Incoming organic-carbon boundary: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「進廠有機碳入口」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at incoming organic-carbon boundary.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
steps.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「進廠有機碳入口」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for incoming organic-carbon boundary; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 初沉碳捕集：表面溢流率與沉降分離：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Primary carbon capture: Surface loading and settling separation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 初沉碳捕集：表面溢流率與沉降分離 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Primary carbon capture: Surface loading and settling separation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 理想沉澱中顆粒沉速相對於表面溢流率決定是否捕集；增加深度主要改變停留與污泥儲存，不能取代表面積。本單元在「初沉碳捕集」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: In ideal settling, particle settling speed relative to surface overflow rate governs capture; greater depth changes retention and sludge storage but cannot replace surface area. Examine this relationship at primary carbon capture.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=6000 m³/d、表面積 A=300 m²。公式 v0=Q/A；代入 6000/300 = 20 m/d。適用邊界：理想離散顆粒近似；絮凝、污泥濃縮、風與短流另行檢核。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=6000 m³/d and surface area A=300 m². Formula v0=Q/A; substitution 6000/300 = 20 m/d. Boundary: Ideal discrete-particle approximation; flocculation, thickening, wind and short-circuiting need separate checks.
steps.failure: 排泥不良會讓泥層抬升，造成出水固體增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Poor sludge withdrawal raises the sludge blanket and increases effluent solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用沉降柱與進出水SS比對捕集，不把水清澈當溶解物已去除。在離線場景為「初沉碳捕集」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Compare a settling-column test and inlet/outlet SS; clear water does not prove dissolved contaminants were removed. Build an offline evidence table for primary carbon capture; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 完成 初沉碳捕集：表面溢流率與沉降分離 的量測或模型練習，記錄與假設的差異。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete the measurement/model exercise for Primary carbon capture: Surface loading and settling separation and record deviations from assumptions.
steps.instruction:
用沉降柱與進出水SS比對捕集，不把水清澈當溶解物已去除。在離線場景為「初沉碳捕集」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
操作任務：先點選「初沉碳捕集」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把面積加至400 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15 m/d。與基準 20 m/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
steps.instructionEn:
Compare a settling-column test and inlet/outlet SS; clear water does not prove dissolved contaminants were removed. Build an offline evidence table for primary carbon capture; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
Action: Select the primary carbon capture measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only area to400 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15 m/d. Compare with baseline 20 m/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=6000 m³/d、表面積 A=300 m²。公式 v0=Q/A；代入 6000/300 = 20 m/d。適用邊界：理想離散顆粒近似；絮凝、污泥濃縮、風與短流另行檢核。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=6000 m³/d and surface area A=300 m². Formula v0=Q/A; substitution 6000/300 = 20 m/d. Boundary: Ideal discrete-particle approximation; flocculation, thickening, wind and short-circuiting need separate checks.
steps.failure: 排泥不良會讓泥層抬升，造成出水固體增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Poor sludge withdrawal raises the sludge blanket and increases effluent solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

steps.title: 濃縮污泥輸送：乾固體與含水率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Thickened-sludge transfer: Dry solids and moisture: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 濃縮污泥輸送：乾固體與含水率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Thickened-sludge transfer: Dry solids and moisture and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 含水污泥總質量由乾固體庫存與固體分率決定；脫水主要移除水而非消滅固體。本單元在「濃縮污泥輸送」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Wet sludge mass follows dry-solids inventory and solids fraction; dewatering removes water rather than destroying solids. Examine this relationship at thickened-sludge transfer.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：乾固體2000 kg/d、固體質量分率0.04。公式 Mwet=MDS/fDS；代入 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d。適用邊界：濃度採質量分率；若體積濃度須先確認密度。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: dry solids2000 kg/d and solids mass fraction0.04. Formula Mwet=MDS/fDS; substitution 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d. Boundary: Concentration is a mass fraction; volumetric concentration requires density.
steps.failure: 把4%寫成4會造成100倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Using4 rather than0.04 produces a hundredfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 秤重並烘乾配對樣品，分開報告乾量與濕量。在離線場景為「濃縮污泥輸送」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Weigh and dry paired samples, reporting wet and dry mass separately. Build an offline evidence table for thickened-sludge transfer; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Predict and recompute 10000 kg/d. Compare with baseline 50000 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

steps.instruction: 把4%寫成4會造成100倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。

steps.failureEn: Using4 rather than0.04 produces a hundredfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

steps.title: 消化槽固體收支：揮發性固體消化：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Digester solids balance: Volatile-solids digestion: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 消化槽固體收支：揮發性固體消化 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Digester solids balance: Volatile-solids digestion and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 厭氧消化將一部分可降解有機固體轉為氣體；惰性固體保留在消化污泥內。本單元在「消化槽固體收支」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Anaerobic digestion converts part of degradable volatile solids to gas; inert solids remain in digestate. Examine this relationship at digester solids balance.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：進料乾固體3000 kg/d、VS分率0.70、VS破壞率0.50。公式 VSdestroyed=MDS fVS η；代入 3000*0.70*0.50 = 1050 kg VS/d。適用邊界：假想穩態質量帳，實際破壞率須以進出料完整固體收支估算。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: feed dry solids3000 kg/d, VS fraction0.70 and VS destruction0.50. Formula VSdestroyed=MDS fVS η; substitution 3000*0.70*0.50 = 1050 kg VS/d. Boundary: Hypothetical steady balance; actual destruction needs complete input/output solids accounting.
steps.failure: 進料量忽高忽低會讓單日去除率誤導。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Variable feeding makes a single-day destruction estimate misleading. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 測進出料TS與VS並檢查貯槽累積，避免以濃度差代替質量差。在離線場景為「消化槽固體收支」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Measure feed/digestate TS and VS and inspect storage accumulation; concentration difference is not mass difference. Build an offline evidence table for digester solids balance; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 區分 消化槽固體收支：揮發性固體消化 的失效原因，提出能排除替代解釋的檢查。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish failure causes in Digester solids balance: Volatile-solids digestion with a check that rules out an alternative explanation.
steps.instruction: 進料量忽高忽低會讓單日去除率誤導。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.instructionEn: Variable feeding makes a single-day destruction estimate misleading. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：進料乾固體3000 kg/d、VS分率0.70、VS破壞率0.50。公式 VSdestroyed=MDS fVS η；代入 3000*0.70*0.50 = 1050 kg VS/d。適用邊界：假想穩態質量帳，實際破壞率須以進出料完整固體收支估算。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: feed dry solids3000 kg/d, VS fraction0.70 and VS destruction0.50. Formula VSdestroyed=MDS fVS η; substitution 3000*0.70*0.50 = 1050 kg VS/d. Boundary: Hypothetical steady balance; actual destruction needs complete input/output solids accounting.
steps.failure: 進料量忽高忽低會讓單日去除率誤導。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Variable feeding makes a single-day destruction estimate misleading. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 測進出料TS與VS並檢查貯槽累積，避免以濃度差代替質量差。在離線場景為「消化槽固體收支」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Measure feed/digestate TS and VS and inspect storage accumulation; concentration difference is not mass difference. Build an offline evidence table for digester solids balance; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.title: 消化槽固體收支：揮發性固體消化

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先點選「消化槽固體收支」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把VS破壞率改成0.60，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 1260 kg VS/d。與基準 1050 kg VS/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the digester solids balance measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only VS destruction to0.60 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 1260 kg VS/d. Compare with baseline 1050 kg VS/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
All ash can turn into methane during anaerobic digestion.

quiz.explanationEn: Variable feeding makes a single-day destruction estimate misleading. Measure feed/digestate TS and VS and inspect storage accumulation; concentration difference is not mass difference. steps.title: 沼氣理論與實收：COD與甲烷理論潛力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Theoretical and collected gas: COD and theoretical methane potential: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 沼氣理論與實收：COD與甲烷理論潛力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Theoretical and collected gas: COD and theoretical methane potential and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 電子當量可把被轉化COD連結到甲烷的理論體積；細胞合成、溶解甲烷與洩漏使實收量較低。本單元在「沼氣理論與實收」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Electron equivalence links converted COD to theoretical methane volume; growth, dissolved methane and leaks reduce collected gas. Examine this relationship at theoretical and collected gas.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：已轉化COD=1000 kg/d、理論上限0.35 Nm³ CH₄/kg COD。公式 VCH4=0.35 CODconverted；代入 0.35*1000 = 350 Nm³ CH₄/d。適用邊界：Nm³採0°C、1atm基準；上限計量而非廠商產氣保證。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: converted COD=1000 kg/d and theoretical upper factor0.35 Nm³ CH₄/kg COD. Formula VCH4=0.35 CODconverted; substitution 0.35*1000 = 350 Nm³ CH₄/d. Boundary: Nm³ uses0°C and1atm; stoichiometric upper bound, not a supplier guarantee.
steps.failure: 把總沼氣量當純甲烷量會高估可用熱值。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Treating total biogas as pure methane overestimates energy. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將氣量修正到同一溫壓，量測甲烷分率與溶解排出。在離線場景為「沼氣理論與實收」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Normalize gas volume to the same temperature/pressure and measure methane fraction and dissolved losses. Build an offline evidence table for theoretical and collected gas; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 辨識 污泥換熱器：污泥加熱與熱回收 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Sludge heat exchanger: Sludge heating and heat recovery and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 顯熱需求取決於質量、比熱與溫差；預熱回收降低外加熱但不改變最終溫度目標的熱力學收支。本單元在「污泥換熱器」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Sensible heat depends on mass, heat capacity and temperature difference; recovery reduces external heat without changing the thermodynamic duty. Examine this relationship at sludge heat exchanger.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：m=10000 kg/d、cp=4.18 kJ/(kg·K)、ΔT=20 K。公式 Qheat=m cp ΔT/3600；代入 10000*4.18*20/3600 = 232.2222 kWh/d。適用邊界：以水近似污泥比熱；不含相變與槽壁損失。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: m=10000 kg/d, cp=4.18 kJ/(kg·K) andΔT=20 K. Formula Qheat=m cp ΔT/3600; substitution 10000*4.18*20/3600 = 232.2222 kWh/d. Boundary: Water-like heat capacity assumed; phase change and wall losses excluded.

steps.failureEn: Fouling can raise hot-side temperature while providing insufficient cold-side heating. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 量測進出溫度及流量，區分換熱回收與燃料投入。在離線場景為「污泥換熱器」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。

steps.objective: 辨識 水線曝氣需求：氧轉移與曝氣功率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Liquid-line aeration demand: Oxygen transfer and aeration power and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 氧需求與設備供氧能力須用相同工況基準；清水標準效率不能直接當污水池中的效率。本單元在「水線曝氣需求」觀察此因果關係。

steps.instructionEn: Energy self-sufficiency compares usable generation and all internal loads within one boundary; an annual net balance does not prove hourly islanded operation. Examine this relationship at whole-plant electricity boundary.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.

steps.title: 垃圾進料質量帳：地磅淨重與物流配對：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 垃圾進料質量帳：地磅淨重與物流配對 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。

steps.instruction: 同一車次總重減空車重得到淨入料；班次總量需以唯一車次編號去重，才能與灰渣、儲坑庫存及能源帳相連。本單元在「垃圾進料質量帳」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Gross minus tare mass for one consignment gives net feed; deduplicated trip IDs connect shift totals to ash, bunker inventory and energy ledgers. Examine this relationship at waste-feed mass ledger.

steps.objective: 辨識 餘熱鍋爐：蒸汽焓差與鍋爐熱量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Heat-recovery boiler: Steam enthalpy rise and boiler duty and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 鍋爐將水的焓提高到蒸汽狀態；應用焓差而不是單靠出口溫度計算熱量。本單元在「餘熱鍋爐」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: A boiler raises feedwater enthalpy to steam conditions; use enthalpy difference rather than outlet temperature alone. Examine this relationship at heat-recovery boiler.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：蒸汽流率5 kg/s、蒸汽與給水焓差2400 kJ/kg。公式 Psteam=m Δh/1000；代入 5*2400/1000 = 12 MW。適用邊界：假想查表焓值已給定；未含排污、蒸汽品質與非穩態。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: steam flow5 kg/s and steam-to-feedwater enthalpy rise2400 kJ/kg. Formula Psteam=m Δh/1000; substitution 5*2400/1000 = 12 MW. Boundary: Hypothetical tabulated enthalpy difference supplied; blowdown, quality and transients excluded.
steps.failure: 將飽和與過熱蒸汽混用會算錯能量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Mixing saturated and superheated states gives an incorrect energy balance. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 使用同時壓力、溫度與流量，從蒸汽表核對焓狀態。在離線場景為「餘熱鍋爐」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Use concurrent pressure, temperature and flow and check enthalpy states in steam tables. Build an offline evidence table for heat-recovery boiler; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instruction: 效率必須明確寫出有用輸出與能量輸入；電效率與含供熱的總效率不可直接比較。本單元在「汽輪機淨發電」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Efficiency needs explicit useful-output and energy-input definitions; electrical and heat-inclusive efficiencies are not directly comparable. Examine this relationship at net turbine electricity.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：熱輸入30 MW、總發電8 MW、廠用1 MW。公式 ηnet=100(Pgross-Paux)/Pfuel；代入 100*(8-1)/30 = 23.33333 %。適用邊界：穩態低位熱值基準；不含供熱信用與生命週期排放。

steps.checkEn: Reconcile fuel heating value, gross generation and auxiliaries over one interval. Build an offline evidence table for net turbine electricity; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 區域供熱介面：熱水迴路的有效供熱：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: District-heating interface: Useful heat in a hot-water loop: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 區域供熱介面：熱水迴路的有效供熱 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of District-heating interface: Useful heat in a hot-water loop and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 供回水溫差與水流量共同決定輸出熱功率；高供水溫度若沒有實際流量或可用負載，就不等於交付熱量。本單元在「區域供熱介面」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Water flow and supply-return temperature difference determine delivered heat; a high supply temperature without flow or useful demand does not constitute heat delivery. Examine this relationship at district-heating interface.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：水質量流率20 kg/s、比熱4.18 kJ/(kg·K)、供回水差20 K。公式 Pheat=mdot cp ΔT；代入 20*4.18*20 = 1672 kW。適用邊界：單相水穩態近似；需在相同交付邊界量測，未扣管網散熱。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: water mass flow20 kg/s, heat capacity4.18 kJ/(kg·K) and supply-return difference20 K. Formula Pheat=mdot cp ΔT; substitution 20*4.18*20 = 1672 kW. Boundary: Steady single-phase water approximation with measurements at one delivery boundary; distribution losses are not deducted.
steps.failure: 回水短路會縮小有效溫差；檢查旁通與負載，而非只提高供水溫度。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: A return-water shortcut reduces useful temperature difference; inspect bypasses and demand before changing supply temperature. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用配對溫度探頭和流量表同步積分，與用戶熱量表比較。在離線場景為「區域供熱介面」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Integrate synchronized matched temperature sensors and flow, then compare with the customer heat meter. Build an offline evidence table for district-heating interface; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 煙氣濾布系統：袋濾器氣布比：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Flue-gas fabric system: Fabric-filter air-to-cloth ratio: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 煙氣濾布系統：袋濾器氣布比 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Flue-gas fabric system: Fabric-filter air-to-cloth ratio and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 氣布比是體積流量除以濾布面積；積塵層能提高捕集但也增加壓差。本單元在「煙氣濾布系統」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Air-to-cloth ratio is gas flow divided by fabric area; a dust cake improves capture while increasing pressure drop. Examine this relationship at flue-gas fabric system.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：實際氣量Q=60000 m³/h、有效濾布A=1000 m²。公式 v=Q/(60A)；代入 60000/(60*1000) = 1 m/min。適用邊界：採實際溫度氣量，不可直接把Nm³當m³；非設備選型限值。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: actual gasQ=60000 m³/h and active clothA=1000 m². Formula v=Q/(60A); substitution 60000/(60*1000) = 1 m/min. Boundary: Use actual-temperature gas volume, not Nm³ directly; not a filter sizing limit.
steps.failure: 濾袋破損可能讓壓差下降同時排放上升。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: A torn bag can lower pressure drop while increasing emissions. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 按隔室紀錄壓差、脈衝與排放趨勢，查破袋或離線面積。在離線場景為「煙氣濾布系統」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Log compartment pressure drop, pulses and emissions and check broken bags or offline area. Build an offline evidence table for flue-gas fabric system; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish failure causes in Flue-gas fabric system: Fabric-filter air-to-cloth ratio with a check that rules out an alternative explanation.
steps.instruction: 濾袋破損可能讓壓差下降同時排放上升。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.instructionEn: A torn bag can lower pressure drop while increasing emissions. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：實際氣量Q=60000 m³/h、有效濾布A=1000 m²。公式 v=Q/(60A)；代入 60000/(60*1000) = 1 m/min。適用邊界：採實際溫度氣量，不可直接把Nm³當m³；非設備選型限值。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: actual gasQ=60000 m³/h and active clothA=1000 m². Formula v=Q/(60A); substitution 60000/(60*1000) = 1 m/min. Boundary: Use actual-temperature gas volume, not Nm³ directly; not a filter sizing limit.
steps.failure: 濾袋破損可能讓壓差下降同時排放上升。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。

steps.check: 按隔室紀錄壓差、脈衝與排放趨勢，查破袋或離線面積。在離線場景為「煙氣濾布系統」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。

steps.title: 煙囪排放質量：煙氣濃度與排放質量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Stack emission mass: Flue-gas concentration and emission mass: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 煙囪排放質量：煙氣濃度與排放質量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Stack emission mass: Flue-gas concentration and emission mass and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 排放質量率取決於濃度乘氣體體積流率；濕乾基、氧校正與標準狀態必須一致。本單元在「煙囪排放質量」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Emission mass rate is concentration times gas flow; wet/dry basis, oxygen correction and standard conditions must agree. Examine this relationship at stack emission mass.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：C=20 mg/Nm³、乾基Q=100000 Nm³/h，兩者同基準。公式 M=CQ/1000000；代入 20*100000/1000000 = 2 kg/h。適用邊界：同基準的示範排放帳；不是任何地區法定排放限值。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: C=20 mg/Nm³ and dryQ=100000 Nm³/h on the same basis. Formula M=CQ/1000000; substitution 20*100000/1000000 = 2 kg/h. Boundary: Same-basis illustrative emissions ledger, not a statutory limit.
steps.failure: 稀釋煙氣可降濃度卻不降污染質量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Diluting flue gas lowers concentration without lowering pollutant mass. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 同步氣量、濃度與氧含量，查校正狀態及無效資料標記。在離線場景為「煙囪排放質量」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Synchronize gas flow, concentration and oxygen while checking calibration and invalid-data flags. Build an offline evidence table for stack emission mass; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.textEn: Select the stack emission mass measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only gas flow to120000 Nm³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2.4 kg/h. Compare with baseline 2 kg/h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 稀釋煙氣可降濃度卻不降污染質量。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。

steps.title: 底渣飛灰分流：灰渣分流與質量帳：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Bottom/fly ash separation: Ash-stream separation and mass balance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 底渣飛灰分流：灰渣分流與質量帳 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Bottom/fly ash separation: Ash-stream separation and mass balance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 底渣與飛灰來源、污染物分布及處置需求不同，必須分流記錄；金屬回收不等於殘渣自動合格。本單元在「底渣飛灰分流」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Bottom ash and fly ash differ in origin, contaminant distribution and management needs; keep separate ledgers, and metal recovery does not automatically certify residues. Examine this relationship at bottom/fly ash separation.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：垃圾100 t/d、假想底渣分率0.20、飛灰分率0.03。公式 Mash=Mw(fbottom+ffly)；代入 100*(0.20+0.03) = 23 t/d。適用邊界：假想濕乾基一致的分率，非實際廠產率；須另考慮添加劑與水分。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: waste100 t/d, assumed bottom-ash fraction0.20 and fly-ash fraction0.03. Formula Mash=Mw(fbottom+ffly); substitution 100*(0.20+0.03) = 23 t/d. Boundary: Hypothetical consistent moisture basis, not actual plant yield; additives and moisture require separate entries.
steps.failure: 混合底渣飛灰會失去追蹤與適切處理的依據。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Mixing bottom and fly ash loses traceability and treatment distinctions. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 各物流秤重並採代表性樣品，維持處置聯單與品質資料。在離線場景為「底渣飛灰分流」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Weigh each stream, take representative samples and retain disposal and quality records. Build an offline evidence table for bottom/fly ash separation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 辨識 廠用與輸出能量：淨電力與廠用負載 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Auxiliaries and exports: Net electricity and auxiliary loads and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 能源自給須以同一邊界比較可用發電與所有廠用電；年度淨額不代表每小時離網。本單元在「廠用與輸出能量」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Energy self-sufficiency compares usable generation and all internal loads within one boundary; an annual net balance does not prove hourly islanded operation. Examine this relationship at auxiliaries and exports.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：發電5000 kWh/d、曝氣2800、泵600、其他400 kWh/d。公式 Enet=Eg-Ea-Ep-Eother；代入 5000-2800-600-400 = 1200 kWh/d。適用邊界：示範日帳，未含備援燃料與尖峰電力容量。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: generation5000 kWh/d, aeration2800, pumping600 and other loads400 kWh/d. Formula Enet=Eg-Ea-Ep-Eother; substitution 5000-2800-600-400 = 1200 kWh/d. Boundary: Illustrative daily ledger; reserve fuel and peak power capacity are omitted.
steps.failure: 漏掉臭氣處理與污泥設備用電會誇大淨盈餘。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Omitting odor and sludge equipment overstates net surplus. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 核對發電、購電與售電表，在相同邊界做全年帳。在離線場景為「廠用與輸出能量」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Reconcile generation, imports and exports within the same boundary over a year. Build an offline evidence table for auxiliaries and exports; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.textEn: Select the auxiliaries and exports measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only aeration demand to3500 kWh/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 500 kWh/d. Compare with baseline 1200 kWh/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

steps.title: 市民環境成效觀察：前後與對照地點比較：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Community environmental outcome: Before-after and control comparison: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 市民環境成效觀察：前後與對照地點比較 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Community environmental outcome: Before-after and control comparison and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 干預前後差異還可能包含天氣與背景趨勢；前後—對照差分可分離共同變化但仍須檢查可比性。本單元在「市民環境成效觀察」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Before-after changes include weather and background trends; difference-in-differences removes common changes but still needs comparable sites. Examine this relationship at community environmental outcome.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：處理地由30降至27，對照地由29降至28，同一指標。公式 effect=(Tafter-Tbefore)-(Cafter-Cbefore)；代入 (27-30)-(28-29) = -2 indicator unit。適用邊界：假設共同背景趨勢；不是隨機試驗或完全因果證明。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: treated site30 to27 and control site29 to28 for the same indicator. Formula effect=(Tafter-Tbefore)-(Cafter-Cbefore); substitution (27-30)-(28-29) = -2 indicator unit. Boundary: Common background trend assumed; not a randomized trial or complete causal proof.
steps.failure: 處理地同時換交通流量會讓單一干預歸因失真。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Concurrent traffic changes at the treated site confound attribution. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 採同期多日資料並檢查前期趨勢，不選只對結果有利的一天。在離線場景為「市民環境成效觀察」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Use simultaneous multi-day data, inspect pre-trends and avoid selecting a favorable day. Build an offline evidence table for community environmental outcome; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：同一車次總重18.6 t、空車重7.4 t。公式 mnet=mgross-mtare；代入 18.6-7.4 = 11.2 t。適用邊界：僅適用同一車輛及相容含水狀態；燃料、乘員與附著水變化另計。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: gross mass18.6 t and tare7.4 t for the same trip. Formula mnet=mgross-mtare; substitution 18.6-7.4 = 11.2 t. Boundary: The same vehicle and compatible moisture basis are required; fuel, occupants and retained water changes are separate.

title: 東京有明水再生中心
summary: 有明的公開流程具有厭氧、無氧、好氧與生物膜過濾，部分出水另作回用。課程讓學徒區分水質處理鏈與再生水用途鏈。
summaryEn: Ariake documents anaerobic, anoxic, aerobic and biofilm-filter processes, with a portion further treated for reuse. The learner separates treatment and end-use chains.

stages.titleEn: System boundaries and observation

steps.title: 分流污水入口：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Separate-sewer influent: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 分流污水入口：污染負荷與採樣邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Separate-sewer influent: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「分流污水入口」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at separate-sewer influent.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
steps.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「分流污水入口」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for separate-sewer influent; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of A₂O internal recycle: Internal recirculation and hydraulic load and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 回流把反應物帶回前段，也增加管線與反應區通過量；回流率不是污染物去除率。本單元在「A₂O內回流」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recirculation returns reactants upstream while increasing pipe and zone throughput; recycle ratio is not removal efficiency. Examine this relationship at A₂O internal recycle.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：進水Q=1000 m³/d、內回流Qr=2000 m³/d。公式 Qzone=Q+Qr；代入 1000+2000 = 3000 m³/d。適用邊界：只計指定區域的循環水力負荷；外部排放仍須另作平衡。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: influentQ=1000 m³/d and internal recycleQr=2000 m³/d. Formula Qzone=Q+Qr; substitution 1000+2000 = 3000 m³/d. Boundary: Hydraulic throughput of one specified zone only; external discharge has a separate balance.
steps.failure: 把回流水加到整廠外部出水會造成假性水量增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Adding recycled flow to external effluent creates fictitious water production. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Aerobic ammonia conversion: Oxygen balance for nitrification and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 氨氮氧化成硝酸鹽消耗氧；以氮質量為基準的化學計量與有機碳需氧量應分別列出。本單元在「好氧區氨轉化」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Oxidizing ammonia nitrogen to nitrate consumes oxygen; nitrogen-based stoichiometry and carbonaceous oxygen demand must be listed separately. Examine this relationship at aerobic ammonia conversion.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想轉化氨氮量N=30 kg N/d、理論係數4.57 kg O₂/kg N。公式 O2=4.57N；代入 4.57*30 = 137.1 kg O₂/d。適用邊界：理論完全氧化上界計量，未扣細胞合成或考慮動力學。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical ammonia conversionN=30 kg N/d and theoretical factor4.57 kg O₂/kg N. Formula O2=4.57N; substitution 4.57*30 = 137.1 kg O₂/d. Boundary: Theoretical complete-oxidation stoichiometry; biomass assimilation and kinetics are omitted.

steps.failureEn: Cold conditions or inhibitors can cause ammonia breakthrough despite normal aeration power. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

steps.checkEn: Check a nitrogen balance using ammonia, nitrite and nitrate rather than DO alone. Build an offline evidence table for aerobic ammonia conversion; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想轉化氨氮量N=30 kg N/d、理論係數4.57 kg O₂/kg N。公式 O2=4.57N；代入 4.57*30 = 137.1 kg O₂/d。適用邊界：理論完全氧化上界計量，未扣細胞合成或考慮動力學。
knowledge.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical ammonia conversionN=30 kg N/d and theoretical factor4.57 kg O₂/kg N. Formula O2=4.57N; substitution 4.57*30 = 137.1 kg O₂/d. Boundary: Theoretical complete-oxidation stoichiometry; biomass assimilation and kinetics are omitted.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先點選「好氧區氨轉化」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把氨氮量改成40 kg N/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 182.8 kg O₂/d。與基準 137.1 kg O₂/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the aerobic ammonia conversion measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only ammonia load to40 kg N/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 182.8 kg O₂/d. Compare with baseline 137.1 kg O₂/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

137.1 kg O₂/d

steps.title: 無氧區電子供體：反硝化的電子供體需求：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Anoxic electron donor: Electron-donor demand for denitrification: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 無氧區電子供體：反硝化的電子供體需求 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Anoxic electron donor: Electron-donor demand for denitrification and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 硝酸鹽還原需要電子供體；理論COD當量僅是起點，可利用碳、細胞產率與溶氧競爭會改變需求。本單元在「無氧區電子供體」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Nitrate reduction needs an electron donor; theoretical COD equivalence is only a starting point because available carbon, growth and oxygen competition alter demand. Examine this relationship at anoxic electron donor.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：待還原硝酸氮20 kg N/d、理論COD當量2.86 kg/kg N。公式 CODmin=2.86N；代入 2.86*20 = 57.2 kg COD/d。適用邊界：理論電子當量示範，不能當現場加藥劑量。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: nitrate nitrogen20 kg N/d and theoretical COD equivalence2.86 kg/kg N. Formula CODmin=2.86N; substitution 2.86*20 = 57.2 kg COD/d. Boundary: Theoretical electron-equivalent illustration; not a field chemical dose.
steps.failure: 回流氧先消耗基質，會讓只按硝酸鹽估碳量的模型偏低。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Returned oxygen consumes substrate and makes a nitrate-only carbon estimate too low. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 同時看硝酸鹽、可利用COD與溶氧，檢查回流帶氧。在離線場景為「無氧區電子供體」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Observe nitrate, available COD and DO together and inspect oxygen introduced by recirculation. Build an offline evidence table for anoxic electron donor; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 辨識 厭氧區磷循環：磷的轉移與污泥排出 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Anaerobic phosphorus cycling: Phosphorus transfer and sludge export and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 除磷須將磷從水相轉入可排出的固體；生物吸收或化學沉澱不能取代最終排泥。本單元在「厭氧區磷循環」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Phosphorus removal transfers phosphorus into solids that can leave the process; uptake or precipitation does not replace sludge export. Examine this relationship at anaerobic phosphorus cycling.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=1500 m³/d、進出水磷差ΔP=3 mg/L。公式 Mremoved=QΔP/1000；代入 1500*3/1000 = 4.5 kg P/d。適用邊界：水相表觀移除，尚需以污泥磷證實去向。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=1500 m³/d and phosphorus differenceΔP=3 mg/L. Formula Mremoved=QΔP/1000; substitution 1500*3/1000 = 4.5 kg P/d. Boundary: Apparent aqueous removal; sludge phosphorus must confirm the destination.
steps.failure: 厭氧區帶入硝酸鹽可能干擾生物除磷；先查回流與碳源。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Nitrate entering an anaerobic zone can disrupt biological phosphorus removal; inspect recycle and carbon first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 同時量測溶解態與總磷、污泥含磷率及排泥量。在離線場景為「厭氧區磷循環」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Measure dissolved and total phosphorus, sludge phosphorus fraction and wasting rate together. Build an offline evidence table for anaerobic phosphorus cycling; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 辨識 生物膜過濾床：生物膜過濾的水力負荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Biofilm filter bed: Hydraulic loading of a biofilm filter and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 通過濾床的水量除以有效面積得到表觀濾速；同一流量遇到停用格或堵塞，剩餘濾格負擔會升高。本單元在「生物膜過濾床」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Flow through a bed divided by active area gives superficial filtration velocity; offline or blocked cells increase loading on the remaining cells. Examine this relationship at biofilm filter bed.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：流量240 m³/h、可用濾床面積80 m²。公式 vf=Q/A；代入 240/80 = 3 m/h。適用邊界：僅為液體表觀濾速，不代替生物反應、氣水逆洗或實際孔隙速度。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: flow240 m³/h and active filter area80 m². Formula vf=Q/A; substitution 240/80 = 3 m/h. Boundary: Superficial liquid velocity only; biological kinetics, air-water backwash and pore velocity are separate.
steps.failure: 未扣反洗中的濾格會低估運轉負荷；先重算可用面積。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Counting a backwashing cell understates operating loading; recompute active area first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 同時讀流量、濾前後水位及濁度，記錄停用濾格與反洗時段。在離線場景為「生物膜過濾床」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Read flow, upstream/downstream level and turbidity together; log offline cells and backwash periods. Build an offline evidence table for biofilm filter bed; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instruction: 注入氣體不等於全部進入水中；尾氣與溶解臭氧共同約束實際轉移量。本單元在「回用水臭氧子系統」觀察此因果關係。

steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想注入2 kg/h、轉移效率0.75、Q=500 m³/h。公式 Dtransferred=1000Minη/Q；代入 1000*2*0.75/500 = 3 mg/L。適用邊界：質量轉移示範，不是消毒信用或微污染物破壞保證。

steps.objective: 區分 回用水臭氧子系統：臭氧轉移與接觸收支 的失效原因，提出能排除替代解釋的檢查。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish failure causes in Reuse-water ozone subsystem: Ozone transfer and contact balance with a check that rules out an alternative explanation.
steps.instruction: 水質氧化需求升高會降低目標物可用的氧化能力。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.instructionEn: Higher water-matrix demand reduces oxidation available to the target compound. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想注入2 kg/h、轉移效率0.75、Q=500 m³/h。公式 Dtransferred=1000Minη/Q；代入 1000*2*0.75/500 = 3 mg/L。適用邊界：質量轉移示範，不是消毒信用或微污染物破壞保證。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical injection2 kg/h, transfer efficiency0.75 andQ=500 m³/h. Formula Dtransferred=1000Minη/Q; substitution 1000*2*0.75/500 = 3 mg/L. Boundary: Mass-transfer illustration, not disinfection credit or guaranteed micropollutant destruction.
steps.failure: 水質氧化需求升高會降低目標物可用的氧化能力。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Higher water-matrix demand reduces oxidation available to the target compound. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 量測尾氣並檢查溴化物與副產物資料，建立目標化合物驗證。在離線場景為「回用水臭氧子系統」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Measure off-gas, review bromide and by-product data and validate the target compound. Build an offline evidence table for reuse-water ozone subsystem; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 建築沖廁需求配對：回用水混合與需求配對：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Building-flushing demand: Reuse blending and demand matching: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 建築沖廁需求配對：回用水混合與需求配對 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Building-flushing demand: Reuse blending and demand matching and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 混合濃度由各水流的質量加權，而不是簡單平均；不同用途的需求與品質應分別核對。本單元在「建築沖廁需求配對」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Blended concentration is mass weighted rather than a simple average; quality and demand must be checked separately for each reuse. Examine this relationship at building-flushing demand.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q1=80、Q2=20 m³/h；C1=5、C2=100 mg/L。公式 Cmix=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)；代入 (80*5+20*100)/(80+20) = 24 mg/L。適用邊界：同一可加成保守溶質；微生物風險與化學相容性不能僅靠此式判斷。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q1=80 and Q2=20 m³/h; C1=5 and C2=100 mg/L. Formula Cmix=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2); substitution (80*5+20*100)/(80+20) = 24 mg/L. Boundary: One additive conservative solute; microbial risk and chemical compatibility cannot be established by this formula.
steps.failure: 混合未完全就採樣會得到隨位置不同的濃度。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Sampling before complete mixing yields position-dependent concentrations. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 檢查流量權重與採樣位置，再用混合後樣品驗證。在離線場景為「建築沖廁需求配對」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Inspect flow weights and sampling locations and verify with a downstream mixed sample. Build an offline evidence table for building-flushing demand; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

workedExample.title: 教學算例

workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. title: 香港昂船洲污水處理廠

steps.title: 深層集水尖峰：尖峰流量與可用能力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Deep-collection peaks: Peak flow and available capacity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 深層集水尖峰：尖峰流量與可用能力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Deep-collection peaks: Peak flow and available capacity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 平均流量用於年收支，尖峰流量決定瞬時水力負荷；泵站、攔污與沉澱單元可能有不同瓶頸。本單元在「深層集水尖峰」觀察此因果關係。

steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：平均 Q=0.8 m³/s、假設尖峰係數 f=2.5。公式 Qp=fQ；代入 0.8*2.5 = 2 m³/s。適用邊界：係數為假設，不能代替地方降雨與下水道時序分析。

steps.failure: 把設計總能力當成檢修時可用能力，會漏算停機風險。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Using installed capacity during maintenance overlooks unavailable equipment. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 把尖峰歷線疊在各單元可用能力上，找出最早溢流點。在離線場景為「深層集水尖峰」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Overlay the peak hydrograph on available capacity for each unit and identify the first overflow point. Build an offline evidence table for deep-collection peaks; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instruction: 連續方程 Q=Av 將流量連到平均流速；局部收縮與阻塞提高流速及水頭損失。本單元在「進水渠道」觀察此因果關係。

steps.title: 提升泵組：提升水頭與電力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Lift pumps: Lift head and electrical power: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 提升泵組：提升水頭與電力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Lift pumps: Lift head and electrical power and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 泵的輸入功率須供應流量的位能增加及損失；效率下降會使同一輸送服務耗電增加。本單元在「提升泵組」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pump input must provide the hydraulic energy increase and losses; lower efficiency increases electricity for the same conveyance service. Examine this relationship at lift pumps.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=0.10 m³/s、H=12 m、總效率η=0.72、ρ=1000 kg/m³。公式 P=ρgQH/(1000η)；代入 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW。適用邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，H含管損；不涵蓋起動、水錘與汽蝕。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=0.10 m³/s, H=12 m, total efficiencyη=0.72 and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Formula P=ρgQH/(1000η); substitution 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW. Boundary: Steady incompressible flow with friction included in H; starting, surge and cavitation are excluded.

steps.failureEn: Impeller wear or throttling changes the operating point; inspect the pump curve. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「提升泵組」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for lift pumps; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: CEPT沉澱池：表面溢流率與沉降分離：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: CEPT sedimentation basin: Surface loading and settling separation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 CEPT沉澱池：表面溢流率與沉降分離 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of CEPT sedimentation basin: Surface loading and settling separation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 理想沉澱中顆粒沉速相對於表面溢流率決定是否捕集；增加深度主要改變停留與污泥儲存，不能取代表面積。本單元在「CEPT沉澱池」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: In ideal settling, particle settling speed relative to surface overflow rate governs capture; greater depth changes retention and sludge storage but cannot replace surface area. Examine this relationship at CEPT sedimentation basin.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=6000 m³/d、表面積 A=300 m²。公式 v0=Q/A；代入 6000/300 = 20 m/d。適用邊界：理想離散顆粒近似；絮凝、污泥濃縮、風與短流另行檢核。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=6000 m³/d and surface area A=300 m². Formula v0=Q/A; substitution 6000/300 = 20 m/d. Boundary: Ideal discrete-particle approximation; flocculation, thickening, wind and short-circuiting need separate checks.
steps.failure: 排泥不良會讓泥層抬升，造成出水固體增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Poor sludge withdrawal raises the sludge blanket and increases effluent solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用沉降柱與進出水SS比對捕集，不把水清澈當溶解物已去除。在離線場景為「CEPT沉澱池」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Compare a settling-column test and inlet/outlet SS; clear water does not prove dissolved contaminants were removed. Build an offline evidence table for CEPT sedimentation basin; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 懸浮固體捕集：去除效率與質量去向：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Suspended-solids capture: Removal efficiency and mass destination: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 懸浮固體捕集：去除效率與質量去向 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Suspended-solids capture: Removal efficiency and mass destination and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 去除是污染物由水相移到污泥或被轉化；以相同流量比較濃度可估效率，但不能省略副產物流。本單元在「懸浮固體捕集」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Removal moves pollutants from water to solids or transforms them; concentration comparison estimates efficiency at equal flows but does not eliminate residual streams. Examine this relationship at suspended-solids capture.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Cin=200 mg/L、Cout=40 mg/L且進出水量相同。公式 η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin；代入 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %。適用邊界：只適用同一物種、同時窗且等流量；不能代替總污染收支。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Cin=200 mg/L and Cout=40 mg/L at equal inlet and outlet flows. Formula η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin; substitution 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %. Boundary: Same species, time window and flow only; not a replacement for a complete pollutant balance.
steps.failure: 以清水稀釋取代處理會讓濃度變低但不一定減少排放質量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Dilution can lower concentration without lowering discharge mass. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 同時量測污泥固體量與水相濃度，對照移除質量。在離線場景為「懸浮固體捕集」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Measure sludge solids and water concentrations together to reconcile removed mass. Build an offline evidence table for suspended-solids capture; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 化學污泥分流：乾固體與含水率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Chemical sludge stream: Dry solids and moisture: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 化學污泥分流：乾固體與含水率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Chemical sludge stream: Dry solids and moisture and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 含水污泥總質量由乾固體庫存與固體分率決定；脫水主要移除水而非消滅固體。本單元在「化學污泥分流」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Wet sludge mass follows dry-solids inventory and solids fraction; dewatering removes water rather than destroying solids. Examine this relationship at chemical sludge stream.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：乾固體2000 kg/d、固體質量分率0.04。公式 Mwet=MDS/fDS；代入 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d。適用邊界：濃度採質量分率；若體積濃度須先確認密度。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: dry solids2000 kg/d and solids mass fraction0.04. Formula Mwet=MDS/fDS; substitution 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d. Boundary: Concentration is a mass fraction; volumetric concentration requires density.
steps.failure: 把4%寫成4會造成100倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Using4 rather than0.04 produces a hundredfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 秤重並烘乾配對樣品，分開報告乾量與濕量。在離線場景為「化學污泥分流」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Weigh and dry paired samples, reporting wet and dry mass separately. Build an offline evidence table for chemical sludge stream; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 末端排放負荷：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Final discharge load: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「末端排放負荷」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at final discharge load.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。

steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「末端排放負荷」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. steps.instruction: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「加藥流量水質連鎖」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at dose/flow/quality instrumentation.

steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. steps.checkEn: Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for dose/flow/quality instrumentation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 都市污水入口：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Urban wastewater entry: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 都市污水入口：污染負荷與採樣邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Urban wastewater entry: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「都市污水入口」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at urban wastewater entry.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
steps.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「都市污水入口」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for urban wastewater entry; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 雙層沉澱面積辨識：表面溢流率與沉降分離：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Double-deck settling area: Surface loading and settling separation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 雙層沉澱面積辨識：表面溢流率與沉降分離 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Double-deck settling area: Surface loading and settling separation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 理想沉澱中顆粒沉速相對於表面溢流率決定是否捕集；增加深度主要改變停留與污泥儲存，不能取代表面積。本單元在「雙層沉澱面積辨識」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: In ideal settling, particle settling speed relative to surface overflow rate governs capture; greater depth changes retention and sludge storage but cannot replace surface area. Examine this relationship at double-deck settling area.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=6000 m³/d、表面積 A=300 m²。公式 v0=Q/A；代入 6000/300 = 20 m/d。適用邊界：理想離散顆粒近似；絮凝、污泥濃縮、風與短流另行檢核。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=6000 m³/d and surface area A=300 m². Formula v0=Q/A; substitution 6000/300 = 20 m/d. Boundary: Ideal discrete-particle approximation; flocculation, thickening, wind and short-circuiting need separate checks.
steps.failure: 排泥不良會讓泥層抬升，造成出水固體增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Poor sludge withdrawal raises the sludge blanket and increases effluent solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用沉降柱與進出水SS比對捕集，不把水清澈當溶解物已去除。在離線場景為「雙層沉澱面積辨識」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Compare a settling-column test and inlet/outlet SS; clear water does not prove dissolved contaminants were removed. Build an offline evidence table for double-deck settling area; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 深槽有效容積：水力停留時間：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Deep-tank active volume: Hydraulic retention time: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 深槽有效容積：水力停留時間 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Deep-tank active volume: Hydraulic retention time and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 名目停留時間 V/Q 是容積周轉時間；短流與死區會使實際停留時間分布偏離此平均值。本單元在「深槽有效容積」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Nominal retention V/Q is a volume turnover time; short-circuiting and dead zones distort the actual residence-time distribution. Examine this relationship at deep-tank active volume.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：有效容積 V=800 m³、流量 Q=2400 m³/d。公式 t=24V/Q；代入 24*800/2400 = 8 h。適用邊界：有效容積不含不可用空間；不代表所有水團均停留同樣久。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: effective volume V=800 m³ and flow Q=2400 m³/d. Formula t=24V/Q; substitution 24*800/2400 = 8 h. Boundary: Effective volume excludes unusable space; not every parcel remains for the same duration.
steps.failure: 隔板破損可能造成短流；擴大容積未必能消除捷徑。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: A broken baffle may create short-circuiting; a larger volume need not remove the shortcut. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用示蹤突破曲線比較平均停留與最早突破，保留流量紀錄。在離線場景為「深槽有效容積」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Compare tracer mean residence and early breakthrough while retaining flow records. Build an offline evidence table for deep-tank active volume; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instructionEn: F/M compares daily organic load with biomass inventory; BOD, COD, MLSS and MLVSS bases must not be mixed. Examine this relationship at staged-feed biological load.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=2000 m³/d、BOD=0.20 kg/m³、V=1000 m³、MLVSS=2 kg/m³。公式 F/M=QS/(VX)；代入 2000*0.20/(1000*2) = 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)。適用邊界：完全混合名目比值，未包含不可生物分解分率與溫度。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=2000 m³/d, BOD=0.20 kg/m³, V=1000 m³ and MLVSS=2 kg/m³. steps.checkEn: Measure flow, biodegradable substrate and volatile solids separately and track effluent trends. Build an offline evidence table for staged-feed biological load; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.text: 把惰性固體當活性生物量，會低估真正食微比。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
knowledge.textEn: Counting inert solids as active biomass understates the true F/M. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先點選「階段進水生物負荷」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把MLVSS降成1.5 kg/m³，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.2666667 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)。與基準 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the staged-feed biological load measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only MLVSS to1.5 kg/m³ with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.2666667 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d). Compare with baseline 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 把惰性固體當活性生物量，會低估真正食微比。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
MLSS與活性微生物量完全等同。
optionsEn: Counting inert solids as active biomass understates the true F/M.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
MLSS is exactly equal to active microbial mass.
quiz.explanation: 把惰性固體當活性生物量，會低估真正食微比。 分別量測流量、可生化基質與揮發性固體，再追蹤出水趨勢。在離線場景為「階段進水生物負荷」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting inert solids as active biomass understates the true F/M. Measure flow, biodegradable substrate and volatile solids separately and track effluent trends. Build an offline evidence table for staged-feed biological load; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 回流排泥固體帳：污泥齡與固體流失：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Return/waste sludge balance: Sludge age and solids losses: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 回流排泥固體帳：污泥齡與固體流失 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Return/waste sludge balance: Sludge age and solids losses and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污泥齡等於系統固體庫存除以每天排出的固體；出水帶泥也必須列入，不只剩餘污泥。本單元在「回流排泥固體帳」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: SRT equals system solids inventory divided by daily solids losses; effluent carryover counts as well as wasting. Examine this relationship at return/waste sludge balance.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：庫存6000 kg、剩餘污泥400 kg/d、出水固體100 kg/d。公式 SRT=M/(W+E)；代入 6000/(400+100) = 12 d。適用邊界：準穩態且計算邊界一致；忽略日內庫存變化。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: inventory6000 kg, wasted solids400 kg/d and effluent solids100 kg/d. Formula SRT=M/(W+E); substitution 6000/(400+100) = 12 d. Boundary: Quasi-steady inventory with consistent boundaries; intraday inventory changes are neglected.
steps.failure: 二沉池帶泥會降低污泥齡，不能只調排泥閥猜測。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Clarifier carryover lowers SRT and cannot be diagnosed by wasting settings alone. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 以排泥流量乘固體濃度，並同步估出水SS負荷。在離線場景為「回流排泥固體帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Multiply wasting flow by solids concentration and estimate concurrent effluent SS load. Build an offline evidence table for return/waste sludge balance; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
