steps.titleEn: Deep-tank aeration power: Oxygen transfer and aeration power: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 深槽曝氣功率：氧轉移與曝氣功率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Deep-tank aeration power: Oxygen transfer and aeration power and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 氧需求與設備供氧能力須用相同工況基準；清水標準效率不能直接當污水池中的效率。本單元在「深槽曝氣功率」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Oxygen demand and equipment transfer capacity require the same conditions; clean-water standard efficiency is not wastewater performance. Examine this relationship at deep-tank aeration power.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想需氧量480 kg O₂/d、現場修正供氧效率1.5 kg O₂/kWh。公式 Pavg=O2/(24 Efield)；代入 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW。適用邊界：平均功率示範，未含尖峰、混合需求或備援餘度。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical oxygen demand480 kg O₂/d and field-corrected efficiency1.5 kg O₂/kWh. Formula Pavg=O2/(24 Efield); substitution 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW. Boundary: Average-power illustration; peaks, mixing requirements and reserve margin are excluded.
steps.failure: 散氣器堵塞會提高壓力而降低氧轉移，風量增加未必有效。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Clogged diffusers can raise pressure while reducing transfer, so more airflow may be ineffective. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

knowledge.textEn: Select the deep-tank aeration power measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only transfer efficiency to1.2 kg O₂/kWh with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 16.66667 kW. Compare with baseline 13.33333 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

steps.objective: 辨識 出水質量驗證：去除效率與質量去向 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Effluent mass verification: Removal efficiency and mass destination and its observable causal relationships.

steps.title: 污泥與臭氣介面：乾固體與含水率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Sludge/odor interface: Dry solids and moisture: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 污泥與臭氣介面：乾固體與含水率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Sludge/odor interface: Dry solids and moisture and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 含水污泥總質量由乾固體庫存與固體分率決定；脫水主要移除水而非消滅固體。本單元在「污泥與臭氣介面」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Wet sludge mass follows dry-solids inventory and solids fraction; dewatering removes water rather than destroying solids. Examine this relationship at sludge/odor interface.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：乾固體2000 kg/d、固體質量分率0.04。公式 Mwet=MDS/fDS；代入 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d。適用邊界：濃度採質量分率；若體積濃度須先確認密度。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: dry solids2000 kg/d and solids mass fraction0.04. Formula Mwet=MDS/fDS; substitution 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d. Boundary: Concentration is a mass fraction; volumetric concentration requires density.
steps.failure: 把4%寫成4會造成100倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Using4 rather than0.04 produces a hundredfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 秤重並烘乾配對樣品，分開報告乾量與濕量。在離線場景為「污泥與臭氣介面」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Weigh and dry paired samples, reporting wet and dry mass separately. Build an offline evidence table for sludge/odor interface; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.title: 污泥與臭氣介面：乾固體與含水率

knowledge.textEn: Select the sludge/odor interface measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only solids fraction to0.20 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 10000 kg/d. Compare with baseline 50000 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
脫水後濕泥減少的質量全都是污染物被破壞。
含水污泥總質量由乾固體庫存與固體分率決定；脫水主要移除水而非消滅固體。

steps.title: 回收水用途：回用水混合與需求配對：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Recycled-water use: Reuse blending and demand matching: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 回收水用途：回用水混合與需求配對 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Recycled-water use: Reuse blending and demand matching and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 混合濃度由各水流的質量加權，而不是簡單平均；不同用途的需求與品質應分別核對。本單元在「回收水用途」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Blended concentration is mass weighted rather than a simple average; quality and demand must be checked separately for each reuse. Examine this relationship at recycled-water use.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q1=80、Q2=20 m³/h；C1=5、C2=100 mg/L。公式 Cmix=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)；代入 (80*5+20*100)/(80+20) = 24 mg/L。適用邊界：同一可加成保守溶質；微生物風險與化學相容性不能僅靠此式判斷。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q1=80 and Q2=20 m³/h; C1=5 and C2=100 mg/L. Formula Cmix=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2); substitution (80*5+20*100)/(80+20) = 24 mg/L. Boundary: One additive conservative solute; microbial risk and chemical compatibility cannot be established by this formula.
steps.failure: 混合未完全就採樣會得到隨位置不同的濃度。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Sampling before complete mixing yields position-dependent concentrations. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 檢查流量權重與採樣位置，再用混合後樣品驗證。在離線場景為「回收水用途」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Inspect flow weights and sampling locations and verify with a downstream mixed sample. Build an offline evidence table for recycled-water use; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 地下空間感測維護：感測器偏移校正：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Underground-space instrumentation: Sensor offset calibration: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 地下空間感測維護：感測器偏移校正 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Underground-space instrumentation: Sensor offset calibration and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「地下空間感測維護」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at underground-space instrumentation.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
steps.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「地下空間感測維護」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for underground-space instrumentation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.

title: 八里污水處理廠
summary: 八里課程聚焦集水、初沉、污泥消化及放流介面，並把跨市流量與設備維護紀錄納入交接；不假設初沉已去除所有溶解污染。
summaryEn: Bali focuses on collection, primary settling, digestion and discharge, including intermunicipal flow and asset records; primary settling is not assumed to remove every dissolved pollutant.

stages.titleEn: System boundaries and observation

steps.title: 跨市集污邊界：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Intermunicipal collection boundary: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 跨市集污邊界：污染負荷與採樣邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Intermunicipal collection boundary: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「跨市集污邊界」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at intermunicipal collection boundary.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
steps.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「跨市集污邊界」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for intermunicipal collection boundary; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 辨識 尖峰流量配置：尖峰流量與可用能力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Peak-flow allocation: Peak flow and available capacity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 平均流量用於年收支，尖峰流量決定瞬時水力負荷；泵站、攔污與沉澱單元可能有不同瓶頸。本單元在「尖峰流量配置」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Mean flow supports annual balances, whereas peak flow governs instantaneous hydraulics; pumps, screens and clarifiers may have different bottlenecks. Examine this relationship at peak-flow allocation.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：平均 Q=0.8 m³/s、假設尖峰係數 f=2.5。公式 Qp=fQ；代入 0.8*2.5 = 2 m³/s。適用邊界：係數為假設，不能代替地方降雨與下水道時序分析。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: mean Q=0.8 m³/s and assumed peak factor f=2.5. Formula Qp=fQ; substitution 0.8*2.5 = 2 m³/s. Boundary: The assumed factor does not replace local rainfall and sewer time-series analysis.

steps.title: 進水提升設備：提升水頭與電力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Influent lift equipment: Lift head and electrical power: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 進水提升設備：提升水頭與電力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Influent lift equipment: Lift head and electrical power and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 泵的輸入功率須供應流量的位能增加及損失；效率下降會使同一輸送服務耗電增加。本單元在「進水提升設備」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pump input must provide the hydraulic energy increase and losses; lower efficiency increases electricity for the same conveyance service. Examine this relationship at influent lift equipment.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=0.10 m³/s、H=12 m、總效率η=0.72、ρ=1000 kg/m³。公式 P=ρgQH/(1000η)；代入 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW。適用邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，H含管損；不涵蓋起動、水錘與汽蝕。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=0.10 m³/s, H=12 m, total efficiencyη=0.72 and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Formula P=ρgQH/(1000η); substitution 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW. Boundary: Steady incompressible flow with friction included in H; starting, surge and cavitation are excluded.
steps.failure: 葉輪磨損或閥門節流會改變工作點，須查泵曲線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Impeller wear or throttling changes the operating point; inspect the pump curve. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「進水提升設備」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for influent lift equipment; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 初級沉澱池：表面溢流率與沉降分離：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Primary clarifier: Surface loading and settling separation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 初級沉澱池：表面溢流率與沉降分離 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Primary clarifier: Surface loading and settling separation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 理想沉澱中顆粒沉速相對於表面溢流率決定是否捕集；增加深度主要改變停留與污泥儲存，不能取代表面積。本單元在「初級沉澱池」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: In ideal settling, particle settling speed relative to surface overflow rate governs capture; greater depth changes retention and sludge storage but cannot replace surface area. Examine this relationship at primary clarifier.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=6000 m³/d、表面積 A=300 m²。公式 v0=Q/A；代入 6000/300 = 20 m/d。適用邊界：理想離散顆粒近似；絮凝、污泥濃縮、風與短流另行檢核。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=6000 m³/d and surface area A=300 m². Formula v0=Q/A; substitution 6000/300 = 20 m/d. Boundary: Ideal discrete-particle approximation; flocculation, thickening, wind and short-circuiting need separate checks.
steps.failure: 排泥不良會讓泥層抬升，造成出水固體增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Poor sludge withdrawal raises the sludge blanket and increases effluent solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用沉降柱與進出水SS比對捕集，不把水清澈當溶解物已去除。在離線場景為「初級沉澱池」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Compare a settling-column test and inlet/outlet SS; clear water does not prove dissolved contaminants were removed. Build an offline evidence table for primary clarifier; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 溶解與顆粒污染區分：去除效率與質量去向：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Dissolved/particulate distinction: Removal efficiency and mass destination: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 溶解與顆粒污染區分：去除效率與質量去向 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Dissolved/particulate distinction: Removal efficiency and mass destination and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 去除是污染物由水相移到污泥或被轉化；以相同流量比較濃度可估效率，但不能省略副產物流。本單元在「溶解與顆粒污染區分」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Removal moves pollutants from water to solids or transforms them; concentration comparison estimates efficiency at equal flows but does not eliminate residual streams. Examine this relationship at dissolved/particulate distinction.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Cin=200 mg/L、Cout=40 mg/L且進出水量相同。公式 η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin；代入 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %。適用邊界：只適用同一物種、同時窗且等流量；不能代替總污染收支。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Cin=200 mg/L and Cout=40 mg/L at equal inlet and outlet flows. Formula η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin; substitution 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %. Boundary: Same species, time window and flow only; not a replacement for a complete pollutant balance.
steps.failure: 以清水稀釋取代處理會讓濃度變低但不一定減少排放質量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Dilution can lower concentration without lowering discharge mass. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 同時量測污泥固體量與水相濃度，對照移除質量。在離線場景為「溶解與顆粒污染區分」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Measure sludge solids and water concentrations together to reconcile removed mass. Build an offline evidence table for dissolved/particulate distinction; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 辨識 污泥濃縮輸送：乾固體與含水率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Sludge thickening/transfer: Dry solids and moisture and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 含水污泥總質量由乾固體庫存與固體分率決定；脫水主要移除水而非消滅固體。本單元在「污泥濃縮輸送」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Wet sludge mass follows dry-solids inventory and solids fraction; dewatering removes water rather than destroying solids. Examine this relationship at sludge thickening/transfer.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：乾固體2000 kg/d、固體質量分率0.04。公式 Mwet=MDS/fDS；代入 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d。適用邊界：濃度採質量分率；若體積濃度須先確認密度。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: dry solids2000 kg/d and solids mass fraction0.04. Formula Mwet=MDS/fDS; substitution 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d. Boundary: Concentration is a mass fraction; volumetric concentration requires density.
steps.failure: 把4%寫成4會造成100倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Using4 rather than0.04 produces a hundredfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 秤重並烘乾配對樣品，分開報告乾量與濕量。在離線場景為「污泥濃縮輸送」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Weigh and dry paired samples, reporting wet and dry mass separately. Build an offline evidence table for sludge thickening/transfer; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 辨識 消化氣計量：COD與甲烷理論潛力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Digester-gas metering: COD and theoretical methane potential and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 電子當量可把被轉化COD連結到甲烷的理論體積；細胞合成、溶解甲烷與洩漏使實收量較低。本單元在「消化氣計量」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Electron equivalence links converted COD to theoretical methane volume; growth, dissolved methane and leaks reduce collected gas. Examine this relationship at digester-gas metering.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：已轉化COD=1000 kg/d、理論上限0.35 Nm³ CH₄/kg COD。公式 VCH4=0.35 CODconverted；代入 0.35*1000 = 350 Nm³ CH₄/d。適用邊界：Nm³採0°C、1atm基準；上限計量而非廠商產氣保證。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: converted COD=1000 kg/d and theoretical upper factor0.35 Nm³ CH₄/kg COD. Formula VCH4=0.35 CODconverted; substitution 0.35*1000 = 350 Nm³ CH₄/d. Boundary: Nm³ uses0°C and1atm; stoichiometric upper bound, not a supplier guarantee.
steps.failure: 把總沼氣量當純甲烷量會高估可用熱值。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Treating total biogas as pure methane overestimates energy. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將氣量修正到同一溫壓，量測甲烷分率與溶解排出。在離線場景為「消化氣計量」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Normalize gas volume to the same temperature/pressure and measure methane fraction and dissolved losses. Build an offline evidence table for digester-gas metering; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Predict and recompute 280 Nm³ CH₄/d. Compare with baseline 350 Nm³ CH₄/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

steps.title: 移交儀表校驗：感測器偏移校正：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Handoff instrument checks: Sensor offset calibration: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 移交儀表校驗：感測器偏移校正 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Handoff instrument checks: Sensor offset calibration and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「移交儀表校驗」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at handoff instrument checks.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Service during equipment renewal: Redundancy and common failures and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 平行備援可降低獨立停機造成的服務中斷，但共同電源、進水或控制器會破壞獨立假設。本單元在「設備更新期間服務」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Parallel redundancy reduces outages from independent failures, but common power, feed or controllers invalidate independence. Examine this relationship at service during equipment renewal.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：兩列各自可用率A=0.95且任一列足以供應示範負載。公式 Asys=1-(1-A)^2；代入 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction。適用邊界：僅兩列獨立且容量足夠；不含共同失效或修復時間分布。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: two trains each have availabilityA=0.95 and either meets the hypothetical load. Formula Asys=1-(1-A)^2; substitution 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction. Boundary: Two independent adequate-capacity trains only; common failures and repair-time distributions are excluded.

steps.failureEn: A shared critical valve can stop both trains together. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

steps.checkEn: Draw a fault tree marking shared assets and replay the process with one train unavailable. Build an offline evidence table for service during equipment renewal; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。

steps.title: 市區收集負荷：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Urban collection load: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 市區收集負荷：污染負荷與採樣邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Urban collection load: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「市區收集負荷」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at urban collection load.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
steps.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「市區收集負荷」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for urban collection load; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 進流泵能源：提升水頭與電力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Influent-pump energy: Lift head and electrical power: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 進流泵能源：提升水頭與電力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Influent-pump energy: Lift head and electrical power and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 泵的輸入功率須供應流量的位能增加及損失；效率下降會使同一輸送服務耗電增加。本單元在「進流泵能源」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pump input must provide the hydraulic energy increase and losses; lower efficiency increases electricity for the same conveyance service. Examine this relationship at influent-pump energy.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=0.10 m³/s、H=12 m、總效率η=0.72、ρ=1000 kg/m³。公式 P=ρgQH/(1000η)；代入 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW。適用邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，H含管損；不涵蓋起動、水錘與汽蝕。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=0.10 m³/s, H=12 m, total efficiencyη=0.72 and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Formula P=ρgQH/(1000η); substitution 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW. Boundary: Steady incompressible flow with friction included in H; starting, surge and cavitation are excluded.
steps.failure: 葉輪磨損或閥門節流會改變工作點，須查泵曲線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Impeller wear or throttling changes the operating point; inspect the pump curve. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「進流泵能源」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for influent-pump energy; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 泵的輸入功率須供應流量的位能增加及損失；效率下降會使同一輸送服務耗電增加。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。

optionsEn: Pump input must provide the hydraulic energy increase and losses; lower efficiency increases electricity for the same conveyance service.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
All pumps consume the same power at equal flow.
quiz.explanation: 泵的輸入功率須供應流量的位能增加及損失；效率下降會使同一輸送服務耗電增加。 同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「進流泵能源」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。

steps.title: 初沉池表面負荷：表面溢流率與沉降分離：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Primary-settler surface loading: Surface loading and settling separation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 初沉池表面負荷：表面溢流率與沉降分離 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Primary-settler surface loading: Surface loading and settling separation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 理想沉澱中顆粒沉速相對於表面溢流率決定是否捕集；增加深度主要改變停留與污泥儲存，不能取代表面積。本單元在「初沉池表面負荷」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: In ideal settling, particle settling speed relative to surface overflow rate governs capture; greater depth changes retention and sludge storage but cannot replace surface area. Examine this relationship at primary-settler surface loading.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=6000 m³/d、表面積 A=300 m²。公式 v0=Q/A；代入 6000/300 = 20 m/d。適用邊界：理想離散顆粒近似；絮凝、污泥濃縮、風與短流另行檢核。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=6000 m³/d and surface area A=300 m². Formula v0=Q/A; substitution 6000/300 = 20 m/d. Boundary: Ideal discrete-particle approximation; flocculation, thickening, wind and short-circuiting need separate checks.
steps.failure: 排泥不良會讓泥層抬升，造成出水固體增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Poor sludge withdrawal raises the sludge blanket and increases effluent solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用沉降柱與進出水SS比對捕集，不把水清澈當溶解物已去除。在離線場景為「初沉池表面負荷」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Compare a settling-column test and inlet/outlet SS; clear water does not prove dissolved contaminants were removed. Build an offline evidence table for primary-settler surface loading; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 辨識 顆粒去除與溶解殘留：去除效率與質量去向 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Particle removal/dissolved residual: Removal efficiency and mass destination and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 去除是污染物由水相移到污泥或被轉化；以相同流量比較濃度可估效率，但不能省略副產物流。本單元在「顆粒去除與溶解殘留」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Removal moves pollutants from water to solids or transforms them; concentration comparison estimates efficiency at equal flows but does not eliminate residual streams. Examine this relationship at particle removal/dissolved residual.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Cin=200 mg/L、Cout=40 mg/L且進出水量相同。公式 η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin；代入 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %。適用邊界：只適用同一物種、同時窗且等流量；不能代替總污染收支。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Cin=200 mg/L and Cout=40 mg/L at equal inlet and outlet flows. Formula η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin; substitution 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %. Boundary: Same species, time window and flow only; not a replacement for a complete pollutant balance.

steps.failureEn: Dilution can lower concentration without lowering discharge mass. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 同時量測污泥固體量與水相濃度，對照移除質量。在離線場景為「顆粒去除與溶解殘留」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Measure sludge solids and water concentrations together to reconcile removed mass. Build an offline evidence table for particle removal/dissolved residual; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 初沉污泥去向：乾固體與含水率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Primary-sludge destination: Dry solids and moisture: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 初沉污泥去向：乾固體與含水率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Primary-sludge destination: Dry solids and moisture and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 含水污泥總質量由乾固體庫存與固體分率決定；脫水主要移除水而非消滅固體。本單元在「初沉污泥去向」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Wet sludge mass follows dry-solids inventory and solids fraction; dewatering removes water rather than destroying solids. Examine this relationship at primary-sludge destination.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：乾固體2000 kg/d、固體質量分率0.04。公式 Mwet=MDS/fDS；代入 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d。適用邊界：濃度採質量分率；若體積濃度須先確認密度。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: dry solids2000 kg/d and solids mass fraction0.04. Formula Mwet=MDS/fDS; substitution 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d. Boundary: Concentration is a mass fraction; volumetric concentration requires density.
steps.failure: 把4%寫成4會造成100倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Using4 rather than0.04 produces a hundredfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 秤重並烘乾配對樣品，分開報告乾量與濕量。在離線場景為「初沉污泥去向」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Weigh and dry paired samples, reporting wet and dry mass separately. Build an offline evidence table for primary-sludge destination; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.checkEn: Integrate five-minute data and compare with the stage-storage curve. Build an offline evidence table for abnormal-flow buffering; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Digital monitoring/pump redundancy: Redundancy and common failures and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 平行備援可降低獨立停機造成的服務中斷，但共同電源、進水或控制器會破壞獨立假設。本單元在「數位監控及泵組備援」觀察此因果關係。

steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：兩列各自可用率A=0.95且任一列足以供應示範負載。公式 Asys=1-(1-A)^2；代入 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction。適用邊界：僅兩列獨立且容量足夠；不含共同失效或修復時間分布。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: two trains each have availabilityA=0.95 and either meets the hypothetical load. Formula Asys=1-(1-A)^2; substitution 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction. Boundary: Two independent adequate-capacity trains only; common failures and repair-time distributions are excluded.
steps.failure: 兩列共用一個關鍵閥門，該閥失效仍會同時停產。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。

environmentExample.description: 單元10基準：數位監控及泵組備援~Unit10 baseline: digital monitoring/pump redundancy

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.

title: 台北北投垃圾焚化廠
summary: 北投課程以進料秤重到灰渣出廠的整條物流為主線，加入中央控制室判讀與環境教育，要求學徒說清每一股副產物去向。
summaryEn: The Beitou course follows material from weighbridge to ash exit, adding control-room interpretation and environmental education; every residual stream must have a stated destination.

steps.instruction: 同一車次總重減空車重得到淨入料；班次總量需以唯一車次編號去重，才能與灰渣、儲坑庫存及能源帳相連。本單元在「進出廠秤重」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Gross minus tare mass for one consignment gives net feed; deduplicated trip IDs connect shift totals to ash, bunker inventory and energy ledgers. Examine this relationship at entry/exit weighing.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：同一車次總重18.6 t、空車重7.4 t。公式 mnet=mgross-mtare；代入 18.6-7.4 = 11.2 t。適用邊界：僅適用同一車輛及相容含水狀態；燃料、乘員與附著水變化另計。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: gross mass18.6 t and tare7.4 t for the same trip. Formula mnet=mgross-mtare; substitution 18.6-7.4 = 11.2 t. Boundary: The same vehicle and compatible moisture basis are required; fuel, occupants and retained water changes are separate.

steps.failureEn: Duplicate trips or the wrong vehicle tare inflate feed; preserve raw tickets and recompute. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 核對車次編號、兩次秤重時間與零點檢查，再比對儲坑日末庫存。在離線場景為「進出廠秤重」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Match trip ID, both weighing times and zero checks, then reconcile closing bunker stock. Build an offline evidence table for entry/exit weighing; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 垃圾混合熱值：垃圾熱值與熱輸入：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Mixed-waste heating value: Waste heating value and heat input: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 垃圾混合熱值：垃圾熱值與熱輸入 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Mixed-waste heating value: Waste heating value and heat input and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 熱輸入由垃圾質量流率及低位熱值決定；水分、惰性物與可燃成分會使同噸數產生不同熱量。本單元在「垃圾混合熱值」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Heat input depends on waste mass flow and lower heating value; moisture, inert material and combustibles change energy at the same tonnage. Examine this relationship at mixed-waste heating value.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：m=10 t/h、LHV=8 MJ/kg。公式 Pthermal=m LHV/3.6；代入 10*8/3.6 = 22.22222 MW。適用邊界：熱輸入示範，不是爐體操作限值或爐排設計。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: m=10 t/h andLHV=8 MJ/kg. Formula Pthermal=m LHV/3.6; substitution 10*8/3.6 = 22.22222 MW. Boundary: Heat-input example, not a furnace operating limit or grate design.
steps.failure: 高含水垃圾可使熱值下降；只依噸數預測發電會偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Wet waste reduces heating value; tonnage alone mispredicts power. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 以代表性混合樣估熱值，核對秤重與蒸汽生成趨勢。在離線場景為「垃圾混合熱值」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Estimate heating value from representative composite samples and compare weighbridge and steam trends. Build an offline evidence table for mixed-waste heating value; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.title: 垃圾混合熱值：垃圾熱值與熱輸入
knowledge.titleEn: Mixed-waste heating value: Waste heating value and heat input
knowledge.text: 熱輸入由垃圾質量流率及低位熱值決定；水分、惰性物與可燃成分會使同噸數產生不同熱量。本單元在「垃圾混合熱值」觀察此因果關係。
knowledge.textEn: Heat input depends on waste mass flow and lower heating value; moisture, inert material and combustibles change energy at the same tonnage. Examine this relationship at mixed-waste heating value.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先點選「垃圾混合熱值」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把LHV改成6 MJ/kg，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 16.66667 MW。與基準 22.22222 MW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the mixed-waste heating value measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only LHV to6 MJ/kg with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 16.66667 MW. Compare with baseline 22.22222 MW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.

steps.instruction: 鍋爐將水的焓提高到蒸汽狀態；應用焓差而不是單靠出口溫度計算熱量。本單元在「鍋爐蒸汽生成」觀察此因果關係。

Formula Psteam=m Δh/1000; substitution 5*2400/1000 = 12 MW. Boundary: Hypothetical tabulated enthalpy difference supplied; blowdown, quality and transients excluded.

steps.title: 總發電與廠用電：淨發電效率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Gross power and auxiliaries: Net electrical efficiency: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 總發電與廠用電：淨發電效率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Gross power and auxiliaries: Net electrical efficiency and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 效率必須明確寫出有用輸出與能量輸入；電效率與含供熱的總效率不可直接比較。本單元在「總發電與廠用電」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Efficiency needs explicit useful-output and energy-input definitions; electrical and heat-inclusive efficiencies are not directly comparable. Examine this relationship at gross power and auxiliaries.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：熱輸入30 MW、總發電8 MW、廠用1 MW。公式 ηnet=100(Pgross-Paux)/Pfuel；代入 100*(8-1)/30 = 23.33333 %。適用邊界：穩態低位熱值基準；不含供熱信用與生命週期排放。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: thermal input30 MW, gross electricity8 MW and auxiliaries1 MW. Formula ηnet=100(Pgross-Paux)/Pfuel; substitution 100*(8-1)/30 = 23.33333 %. Boundary: Steady lower-heating-value basis; heat credit and life-cycle emissions excluded.
steps.failure: 用高位熱值輸入搭配低位熱值比較值會錯置效率。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Mixing higher- and lower-heating-value bases distorts comparisons. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 以共同時窗核對燃料熱值、總發電與廠用負載。在離線場景為「總發電與廠用電」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Reconcile fuel heating value, gross generation and auxiliaries over one interval. Build an offline evidence table for gross power and auxiliaries; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 煙氣除塵模組：袋濾器氣布比：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Flue-gas dust module: Fabric-filter air-to-cloth ratio: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 煙氣除塵模組：袋濾器氣布比 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Flue-gas dust module: Fabric-filter air-to-cloth ratio and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 氣布比是體積流量除以濾布面積；積塵層能提高捕集但也增加壓差。本單元在「煙氣除塵模組」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Air-to-cloth ratio is gas flow divided by fabric area; a dust cake improves capture while increasing pressure drop. Examine this relationship at flue-gas dust module.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：實際氣量Q=60000 m³/h、有效濾布A=1000 m²。公式 v=Q/(60A)；代入 60000/(60*1000) = 1 m/min。適用邊界：採實際溫度氣量，不可直接把Nm³當m³；非設備選型限值。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: actual gasQ=60000 m³/h and active clothA=1000 m². Formula v=Q/(60A); substitution 60000/(60*1000) = 1 m/min. Boundary: Use actual-temperature gas volume, not Nm³ directly; not a filter sizing limit.
steps.failure: 濾袋破損可能讓壓差下降同時排放上升。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: A torn bag can lower pressure drop while increasing emissions. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 按隔室紀錄壓差、脈衝與排放趨勢，查破袋或離線面積。在離線場景為「煙氣除塵模組」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Log compartment pressure drop, pulses and emissions and check broken bags or offline area. Build an offline evidence table for flue-gas dust module; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 辨識 控制室排放判讀：煙氣濃度與排放質量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Control-room emission reading: Flue-gas concentration and emission mass and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 排放質量率取決於濃度乘氣體體積流率；濕乾基、氧校正與標準狀態必須一致。本單元在「控制室排放判讀」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Emission mass rate is concentration times gas flow; wet/dry basis, oxygen correction and standard conditions must agree. Examine this relationship at control-room emission reading.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：C=20 mg/Nm³、乾基Q=100000 Nm³/h，兩者同基準。公式 M=CQ/1000000；代入 20*100000/1000000 = 2 kg/h。適用邊界：同基準的示範排放帳；不是任何地區法定排放限值。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: C=20 mg/Nm³ and dryQ=100000 Nm³/h on the same basis. Formula M=CQ/1000000; substitution 20*100000/1000000 = 2 kg/h. Boundary: Same-basis illustrative emissions ledger, not a statutory limit.
steps.failure: 稀釋煙氣可降濃度卻不降污染質量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Diluting flue gas lowers concentration without lowering pollutant mass. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 同步氣量、濃度與氧含量，查校正狀態及無效資料標記。在離線場景為「控制室排放判讀」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Synchronize gas flow, concentration and oxygen while checking calibration and invalid-data flags. Build an offline evidence table for control-room emission reading; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 底渣飛灰分帳：灰渣分流與質量帳：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Separate ash ledgers: Ash-stream separation and mass balance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 底渣飛灰分帳：灰渣分流與質量帳 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Separate ash ledgers: Ash-stream separation and mass balance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 底渣與飛灰來源、污染物分布及處置需求不同，必須分流記錄；金屬回收不等於殘渣自動合格。本單元在「底渣飛灰分帳」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Bottom ash and fly ash differ in origin, contaminant distribution and management needs; keep separate ledgers, and metal recovery does not automatically certify residues. Examine this relationship at separate ash ledgers.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：垃圾100 t/d、假想底渣分率0.20、飛灰分率0.03。公式 Mash=Mw(fbottom+ffly)；代入 100*(0.20+0.03) = 23 t/d。適用邊界：假想濕乾基一致的分率，非實際廠產率；須另考慮添加劑與水分。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: waste100 t/d, assumed bottom-ash fraction0.20 and fly-ash fraction0.03. Formula Mash=Mw(fbottom+ffly); substitution 100*(0.20+0.03) = 23 t/d. Boundary: Hypothetical consistent moisture basis, not actual plant yield; additives and moisture require separate entries.
steps.failure: 混合底渣飛灰會失去追蹤與適切處理的依據。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Mixing bottom and fly ash loses traceability and treatment distinctions. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 各物流秤重並採代表性樣品，維持處置聯單與品質資料。在離線場景為「底渣飛灰分帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Weigh each stream, take representative samples and retain disposal and quality records. Build an offline evidence table for separate ash ledgers; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 辨識 廠內熱回收：熱水迴路的有效供熱 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Internal heat recovery: Useful heat in a hot-water loop and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 供回水溫差與水流量共同決定輸出熱功率；高供水溫度若沒有實際流量或可用負載，就不等於交付熱量。本單元在「廠內熱回收」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Water flow and supply-return temperature difference determine delivered heat; a high supply temperature without flow or useful demand does not constitute heat delivery. Examine this relationship at internal heat recovery.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：水質量流率20 kg/s、比熱4.18 kJ/(kg·K)、供回水差20 K。公式 Pheat=mdot cp ΔT；代入 20*4.18*20 = 1672 kW。適用邊界：單相水穩態近似；需在相同交付邊界量測，未扣管網散熱。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: water mass flow20 kg/s, heat capacity4.18 kJ/(kg·K) and supply-return difference20 K. Formula Pheat=mdot cp ΔT; substitution 20*4.18*20 = 1672 kW. Boundary: Steady single-phase water approximation with measurements at one delivery boundary; distribution losses are not deducted.

steps.failureEn: A return-water shortcut reduces useful temperature difference; inspect bypasses and demand before changing supply temperature. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用配對溫度探頭和流量表同步積分，與用戶熱量表比較。在離線場景為「廠內熱回收」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Integrate synchronized matched temperature sensors and flow, then compare with the customer heat meter. Build an offline evidence table for internal heat recovery; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Continuous-monitor calibration: Sensor offset calibration and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「連續監測校正」觀察此因果關係。

steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. steps.checkEn: Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for continuous-monitor calibration; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：同一車次總重18.6 t、空車重7.4 t。公式 mnet=mgross-mtare；代入 18.6-7.4 = 11.2 t。適用邊界：僅適用同一車輛及相容含水狀態；燃料、乘員與附著水變化另計。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: gross mass18.6 t and tare7.4 t for the same trip. Formula mnet=mgross-mtare; substitution 18.6-7.4 = 11.2 t. Boundary: The same vehicle and compatible moisture basis are required; fuel, occupants and retained water changes are separate.
